/gnyis pa ni rdzogs rim sgom ma sgom gang ltar kyang bskyed rim rags pa mthar phyin pa ste/ ye shes la dbang ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams 'grub pa'i dus dang rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa cung zad brtan nas/ rnal 'byor bzhi par sleb pa'i tshe/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i don du spyod pa byed pa ste/ bskyed rim pa dang rdzogs rim pas thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i dus gnyis dang*/ rdzogs rim pas drod thob pa nas rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub pa'i phyir spyod pa byed pa dang*/ de grub nas don gyi ye shes zung 'jug dang bcas pa thob pa'i phyir spyod pa dang*/ slob pa'i zung 'jug thob nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob pa'i phyir du spyod pa ste/ rdzogs rim gyi drod thob pa phan chad spyod pa kho na gtso bor byed pa yin mod kyi/ sa mtshams la ltos nas de ltar gsum te spyir lnga'o/ /rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub phyir du nges par spyod mi dgos pa dang*/ thun mong gi gnyis po'ang mtha' gcig tu mi dgos pas nges par dgos pa'i dus ni gnyis so/ /'on kyang sgyu lus 'phral du 'grub 'dod na/ rdzogs rim pas drod thob ma thag nas spyod pa bya'o/ kha cig bskyed rim shin tu phra ba la brtan pa thob nas thun mong gi dngos grub zla ba phyed sogs dus myur bar 'grub pa'i spyod pa byed pa ni/ bskyed rim pa'i spyod pa'i skabs yin zhing*/ rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa yin phyin chad thun mong gi dngos grub kyi phyir ma yin pas khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ bskyed rim shin tu phra ba la dbang 'byor ba ye shes la ches dbang ba ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon po'i skabs su 'byung ba yin zhes smra ba ni shin tu nang 'gal te/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon por song ba'i skabs kyi rnal 'byor pa de bskyed rim pa yin pa ga la srid/

yang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi don du spyod pa byed pa thams cad sngags kyi gdul bya dbang po dman pa yin zhes pa yang mtha' cig tu nges pa ma yin te/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus khyad par can ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams rjes su 'brang ba la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par sgrub par 'dus pa la sogs par gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ gang zag de'i rgyud la yod pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ye shes kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim gyi rig 'dzin du smos kyi/ bskyed rim pa'i gang zag ni ma yin te/ sbyor lam tsam yang ma thob pa'i gang zag la de lta bu'i yon tan mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de lta bu'i yon tan thob na/ de 'dra ma thob ba'i sgyu lus grub pa las 'gro don spyod pa la mthu ches che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rnon po rnams kyi don du gnyer bya kho na ste/ 'gro don byed pa la lhag par mthu che ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na rgyud rnams las thun mong gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba dbang po rtul por ma gsung ngam zhe na/ 'gro don spyod pa la gsungs mod/ de ni skye ba 'di la de nyid thob bya'i gtso bor byed pa la gsungs kyi/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa tsam ga la 'gal/ legs tshogs grub pa don gnyer dang*/ zas gos don gnyer yang dbang po rtul por gsungs mod kyi/ dbang po rnon pos las tshogs don gnyer yang mi rung ba ma yin la/ zas bza' ba dang gos bgor mi rung ba ma yin pa bzhin no/ kha cig rdzogs rim pa'i snang ba'i rtogs pa yan chad rang lus kyi lam kho nas sgrub pa de nges par las kyi rig ma la brten te sgyu lus sgrub dgos pas/ spyod pa byed dgos zhes kyang zer la/ yang skabs gang du spyod pa gsum gang spyad kyang rung bar smra ba nang 'gal zhing*/ sgyu lus rig ma la brten nas sgrub dgos kyang*/

spyod pa dgos pas ma khyab ste des drod thob nas 'dod na spyod pa byed ces pas re shig de tsam 'grub pa la mi 'dod na spyod pa ma byas kyang rung ba'i tshig go /spyod pa byed pa spyi'i dus ni/ drod thob pa zhes bya ba ste/ de yang*/ phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshai bas mi gnod pa dang*/ rkyen gang gis kyang ting nge 'dzin las g.yo mi thub pa dang*/ chos brgyad mngon gyur mgo snyoms pa dang*/ yul snang spyi dang khyad par 'dod yon gyis ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba na/ drod thob pa ste/ drod kyi don yang dngos grub me lta bu 'byung ba'i snga ltas drod lta bu yin pas te/ dgos pa rdo rje dang*/ saṃ pu ṭir yang cung zad drod ni thob na/ zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar dro ba'i bya ba dang*/ /mngon par 'bad pas rtogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bskyed rim gyi dngos grub 'grub pa la/ 'dod pa'i lha mnyes nas gnang ba dngos thob pa dgos la/ rdzogs rim pa'i drod la ni che chung gsum yod de/ chung ngu ni gong du bshad pa de nyid yid te/ 'on kyang khyad par ni rdzogs rim nyid la brten te de dag thob pa dgos shing*/ 'bring gis ni tshar bcad kyi lta stangs bzhi la sogs pa legs par grub pa dang*/ chen po ni rjes su 'dzin pa'i lta stangs grub pa phan chad kyi nus pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa thob pa'o/ kha cig lta stangs bzhi bskyed rim mthar phyin pa nas 'grub pa dang*/ chos brgyad kyi rtogs pa mgo snyoms pa tshogs lam nas 'byung bas drod chung gi rnam gzhag de dag mi 'thad ces smra ba ni/ rgyal po'am rang gi bla mas dgag pa byed dgos pa'i khral brdas pa zhig yin la rag ste/ rgyu mtshan med par mu cor smra ba 'di ni ci zhig bya/ lta stangs bzhi bskyed rim 'ba' zhig gi 'bras bu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag sna cig kyang ston rgyu med cing*/

gnod byed 'di ltar yod de/ lta stangs nyid kyi sgrub pa la bum can la sogs pa'i rlung sbyor zla ba drug par re sgom dgos par gsungs pa/ dus 'khor las bum can zla drug sgom na/ srog rtsol gyi lam mthar phyin par yang bshad pas/ gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis sgom pa'i sgrub pa po rlung sbyor ba bzhi zla ba drug re bsgoms kyang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa sna cig kyang mi skye ba'i sngags kyi gdul bya dbang po rnon po de 'dra khyed kho na 'dod par byed mod kyi shes ldan su zhig 'dod/ de lta bu'i gang zag de yang khyed kho na'o/ /zhes kyang bzhad gad bya'o/ /'o na man ngag snye ma las/ gang las 'dir rnal 'byor la dga' bas rab tu mgu bar 'gyur ba dang*/ glags tshol ba rnams kyis kyang 'di la mi bzod pa dang*/ tshar gcod pa dang rjes su 'dzin pa nus pa 'di rnams 'gyur ba dang grang ba rlung la sogs pa rnams kyis zil gyis mi non pa'o/ /zhes tshar bcad rjes bzung thams cad 'grub par bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de drod thob pa'i rtags su bshad kyi/ drod thob tshad la de yod pas ma khyab ste/ dpal gsang ba grub pa las rig spyod kyi skabs su/ lha rdzas btsun mo dgug pa yi/ /nus pa gal te med gyur na/ /des ni mi yi bu mo bsten/ /zhes drod thob nas spyod pa spyod pa'i gang zag la tshar bcad rjes 'dzin thams cad lta ci smos/ lha mo sogs 'gugs pa'i nus pa yang med par 'byung bar bshad pas so/ /drod chung ngu sbyor lam thob pa'i snga ltas zhes pa dang*/ drod nyid sbyor lam drod du bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed pa la nang 'gal bsdebs par byed de/ 'di ni tshig 'khri tsam gyi rtsod pa stai/ sbyor lam phyi ma rnams kyi snga ltas sbyor lam drod nas 'byung ba ci phyir 'gal/ sbyor lam rtse mo'i snga ltas de sbyor lam gyi snga ltas ma yin na/ lam gzhan rnams kyi snga ltas ni de bas kyang ma yin pas/

lam skye ba'i snga ltas ma yin pa dang*/ de yang de lta na de lam ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /de sbyor lam gyi snga ltas ma yin te/ sbyor lam gzhan skyes zin pa'i phyir snyam na/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas de nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas ma yin par 'gyur te/ tshes bcu bzhi yan chad nyi ma shar zin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bod phyi ma rnams kyi brgal brtag 'di dag ni snying po med pa 'ba' zhig go /des na bskyed rim drod thob nas/ thun mong gi don du spyod pa spyod/ rdzogs rim gyi drod thob nas mchog gi don du spyod pa spyod do/ /zhes pa ni grub pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dngos grub gnyis dngos su sgrub par byed pa dang*/ grub pa de nyid gong 'phel du song nas mthar phyin par byed pa yin la/ rang lus dang gzhan lus kyi lam gyis ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa brtan par byas zin kyang*/ da dung rten lus dag par byed pa dang*/ brten pa ye shes bogs 'byin rgyu mang po yod pa sngar gi lam gyi rgyun tsam gom par byas kyang*/ tshe 'di la mthar phyin par mi nus pas/ rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi 'dod yon gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dod pa lnga la rol pa'i spyod lam 'khor bcas 'ba' zhig la gril te bogs phyung na/ ches byang bar du zhugs pa'i rim pas 'phral du mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du yang*/ /de nas spyod dang brtul zhugs dpal/ /pho nya mo rnams rab sgrub byed/ /myur du sgrub byed 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ kyai rdor las kyang*/ spyod pa pha rol phyin mchog nyid/ /gang gi dngos grub mthar 'gro ba/ /zhes dang*/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las kyang*/ dga' ba'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /skye ba'i rgya mtsho rab 'jigs las/ /sems can thams cad sgrol byed pa/ /nyams med par ni 'gro ba'i gru/ /myur du dngos grub byed pa'i mchog/ces gsungs so/

/spyod pa'i phyag rgya rnams kyi ngo bo dang*/ grangs dang*/ 'gro ba so so'i khyad par dang*/ nus pa che chung gi dbye ba las kyang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba du ma 'dren nus shing*/ des stong pa nyid rtogs tshul la yang re res khyad par du 'gyur te/ dper na lus kyi gnas so sor gnad du snun pa las nyams kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba re re skye ba bzhin no/ /des na rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ phyag rgya'i bha ga'i khyad par so so'i byang chub kyi sems 'ching tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa dang*/ kun bzang gi spyod pa dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa'o/ /dang po la gsang ba'i spyod pa zhes kyang bya te/ gsum char yod kyang spros med shas che/ gnyis pa la spros bcas dang spros med gnyis cha mnyam/ gsum pa la spros bcas shas che ba yin no/ /de la a wa dhū tī'i don dhu no ti te sdig pa skrod par zhes par 'gro/ gnyis spangs dang kun 'dar zhes par 'gro ste/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ sdig bcom spyod pa 'dis myur thob ces kyang gsungs/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi gnas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni sgom byed pa/ /a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa bshad/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /zhes gsungs pas sdig pa dag pa dang*/ gnyis snang gi rnam rtog dang por 'joms byed yin pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin nam bden 'dzin ni g.yo zhing 'dar ba dang*/ bskyod par byed pa'i don no/ /kun bzang gi don ni/ des bya ba ci byed thams cad bzang ngan gang du snang yang dus kun tu ngo bo bzang po 'ba' zhig yin pa'o/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal ni nyon mongs las dngos su rgyal zhing bdud bzhi po rnams btul ba dang*/ sems can gyi don la stobs dang ldan pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang 'joms bzhin pa yin pas so/ /'di dag dang po gnyis gtso bor sbyor lam skabs dang phyi ma gtso bor 'phags lam du sbyor mod/

gsum char la skyes 'phags gnyis ka yod do/ /lnga pa la/ spyod pa rgyu ba'i yul/ grogs phyag rgya ma/ spyod pa'i kun slong*/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ cha lugs sgyur ba'i khyad par/ 'gro ba'i dus kyi bya ba/ bsten bya 'dod yon/ spyod pa'i bslab bya spyod pa'i phan yon/ ji ltar spyod pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yul dang yul du 'gro ba yi/ /pho nya'i gzugs ni mtshon pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gtso bo yongs su grags pa 'dzam bu gling gi yul so gnyis po rnams dang*/ phyogs mthun bod la sogs pa'i rgyal khams re re la yang yul chen de dag tshang bar rtsi zhing*/ grong khyer gcig nyid la yang tshang ba'o/ /tshang ba'i go don yang sa bcu che chung la gnas pa'i pho nya mo rnams gnas pa yin pa dang*/ bdag nyid la de dag gi rtaugs pa skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i phyir yul chen rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i yul thams cad du/ grub chen dza lan+dha ri pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ yul dang yul 'khor thams cad sa bcu yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ rdzaugs rim dang bskyed rim dang gnyis ka'i thun mong gsum las/ dang po rtsa rgyud las/ rigs lnga la ni kun spyod pa/ / rigs ni rnam pa bzhi ru grags/ /rigs gcig la ni kun spyod pa/ rnal 'byor grub don rab tu mchod/ /ces bram ze rje'u rigs dmangs rigs gdol ba la sogs bzang ngan thams cad la rigs gcig pa'i tshul gyis mnyam pa nyid du byed pa dang*/ de bzhin du gzugs dang lang tsho 'gro ba'i rigs dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi tshang ma tshang ji ltar rnyed pa thams cad phyogs med du bsten pa ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang*/ bu mo rgan mo dar ma rnams dang lus ni dri mar bcas dang bram ze mo dang rgyal rigs mo/ /rje mo dmangs mo mthar skyes rna mig lag dang bral ba rna ba mchu dang sna ni chang ma rnams/ /mtha' dag byang chub rgyu ru shes rab thabs kyis mchod par byas te rgyal po slob dpon snying rje dang*/

bcas pa'i thugs rjes dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing byang chub spyod la rjes su chags pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir phyag rgya'i gtso bo rnams rang gi rigs so sor nges par byed pa dang*/ khyad par rgyud 'di'i lus kyi rgyud las/ pho nya mo yi sgrub pa gnyis/ /dngos grub cho ga la spyod tshe/ /pho nya gcig pu kho na yin/ /rab dga' nyid dang dngos grub ni/ /zhing rnams gnas su grub pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma dag rnam par gnas/ /zhes gsungs te/ zhing skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma'i 'du ba thob par byed pa'i sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i tshe/ sngags skyes kyi pho nya mo 'ba' zhig las gzhan mi bsten te/ de'i bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyir pho nya gcig pu kho na zhes gsungs so/ /zhing skyes kyi 'du ba thob nas ni/ gnyis char bsten pa yin te/ pho nya mo'i sgrub pa lugs gcig go /yang na der gnas pa yi bzlas pa bya/ /zas rnyed pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /zhes gnod sbyin mo la sogs phyag rgyar sgrub ste/ des rang la kha zas sbyin pa sogs byed pa gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa ni rtsa rgyud las/ lce sbom mig ni dmar ser la/ rtsub cing spu ni dmar ser yin/ /zhes pad+ma can sogs bzhi dang*/ spyi'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ dngos grub kun gyi thun mong du/ bzlas dang brtul zhugs la rtag dga'/ dran pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /zhes dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim thob pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni sngags legs ldan/ /pho nya rnams su yang dag bshad/ /phyag rgya legs sbyor dang tshul dang*/ /chags med gtong dang tshul khrims ldan/ /ye shes rgyu skyes yang dag rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngags la mos shing dran pa dang ldan pa'i bud med bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa las 'byung ba'i dbang bskur bas dam tshig thob par byas shing rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba legs par bsgom pa dang*/ sbyin pa la dga' ba dang*/ 'dod yon gyi g.yeng ba la chags pa shas chung ba dang*/

yul rnams la ma bkag par longs spyod pa'i bde ba chen por sgrub par nus pa sngags lugs kyi dbang po'i sgo sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa po la ye shes rdzogs par bskyed pa'i rgyu'i nus pa can ni/ spyod pa gnyis ka'i grogs phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ sbyangs pa las thob pa'i pho nya mo'o/ /pho nya mo'i mtshan nyid rnams ni mdo tsam du bshad zin to/ /'dir phyag rgya 'jug ldog gi khyad par ni 'di ltar/ rnal 'byor lam byang yang*/ man ngag thob pa tsam gyis kun+da 'ching bar nus pas ni lam sgom pa'i dang po nyid nas kyang bsten du rung mod/ 'on kyang spyir btang tu thog mar dbang bskur ba'i dus ma gtogs/ re zhig rnal 'byor la bten te 'gyur ba ma khegs kyi bar du las kyi phyag rgya mi bsten pa dang por 'jug/de nas ldog pa'o/ /mtshams de nas ye shes mchog thob pa'i phyir du phyag rgya la 'jug la/ 'gyur ba khegs nas 'khor lor ma bsten pa'i bar du ci rigs

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ ci rigs su £© ldog pa'i skabs kyang yod do/ /de nas sgrub pa'i phyag rgya ldog nas zhing gi pho nya mo rnams kyi 'du ba la 'jug pa ni/ sbyor lam gyi spyod pa'i skabs dang nges pa'i phyag rgya ldog nas/ sprul pa sna tshogs pas 'jug pa ni zung 'jug phan chad do/ /sbyor lam gyi spyod pa'i skabs su yang zhing gi pho nya mo nges pa las ldog ste/ phyogs med du 'jug pa yang yod la/ mngon par byang chub pa gnyis kyi skabs su de dang de'i mthar thug gi phyag rgya la 'jug cing gzhan las ldog pa'o/ /'jug ldog kyang gtso bor 'jug ldog yin gyi gtan nas 'jug par byed pa ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ grol ba'i don dang de don du/ /dam tshig spyod pa nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bdag nyid grol ba dang sems can rnams grol ba'i don du spyod pa la 'jug pa kho na'i bsam pa dgos kyi/ bdag nyid bzang por ston pa'am/ bza' btung gos la sogs pa don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas spyod pa la 'jug pa ni mi rung ngo*/ /sdom 'byung las/ nor dang chung ma de bzhin srog/dbul zhing sbyin par bya ba nyid/ mdud pa 'di gsum las grol nas/ /rtag tu spyod pa bya ba yin/ zhes gsungs te/ longs spyod la zhen pa med pa dang*/ sems can la snying rje chen po dang*/ rang gi lus sems can thams cad la yongs su sbyin zin pa'i sems te/ bsam pa rnam pa lnga po des kun nas bslangs pa'o/ /kyai rdo rje las/ lus kyi sbyin pa byin nas ni/ /phyi nas sbyong ba yang dag spyod/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dir lus sems can rnams la sbyin pa'i don yang*/ rdzu 'phrul mchog ma thob bar du lus bcad cing sbyin pa ni ma yin la/ lus kyi bya ba gang cung zad byed pa/ mtha' na dbugs phyi nang du 'gyur ba tshun chad sems can mtha' dag sgrol ba'i don du dmigs pa de/ lus sems can la sbyin pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ni/

bskyed rim gyi spyod pa yin na/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i 'khor lo go cha dang bcas pa 'bral ba med pa bsgom pa dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan g.yo thams cad mos pas rnam par lta ba dang*/ rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa la ni thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa ste/ ji skad du/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*/ /zhes sogs rdzogs rim gyi sgom bsam dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag las 'das mtshon cha ni/ /lus la gnas pa kun tu spyad/ /ces bskyed rim pa'i sgom bsam gsungs so/ /lnga pa ni/ lha'i chas su 'jug pa ste/ rgyud 'dir ni dpal he ru ka'i chas su 'jug pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan mo rtag par nam mkha'i gos/ /gnag dang dmar ba rtag 'gyur bya/ /srog chags yan lag las byung gyon/ /bde ba spyod pas bde thob 'gyur/ /mchod phyir thogs nas yongs spangs gtsang*/ /shrī he ru kar byin gyis brlabs/ /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /dus kun tu ni yang dag spyad/ /zhes bdag nyid he ru ka dang mthun pa'i kha dog nag po dang*/ phyag rgya yul dang mthun pa'i dmar po sgyur zhing*/ he ru ka'i sngags kyis de'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang mchod phyir thogs te rig byed las 'byung ba'i se ral kha'i gtsang sbra spangs te/ rkun ma'i skra'i mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba ste/ phyag mtshan kyang he ru ka'i phyag mtshan gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin zh-ing*/ hūṃ zhes bya ba dang rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bar byed pa yin no/ /'dir rdo rje dril bu dang phyag rgya lnga'am drug dang cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid dang rnam gzhag rgyas pa gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /kyai rdo rjer ni/

kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzugs shes rab ste/ /thabs kyi gzugs nyid cang te'u nyid/ /ces pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga shes rab dang*/ ḍā ma ru thabs su bstan pa'ang yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ zhes kha ṭ+wāṃ ga snang stong gnyis su med pa'i lha sku bde ba chen po'i thabs dang*/ ḍā ma ru ni spros pa thams dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid shes rab dang*/ thod pa bde ba chen po dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin pas/ de rnams sems gcig nyid ye shes de dag gi ngo bor snang ba mtshon no/ /drug pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bsam pa'i bdag nyid nang par langs/ /lus kyi bya ba kun byas te/ /zhes pa dang*/ dag byed byas pa'i lus ngag ni/ /rtag tu sngags ni brjod par bya/ /rtag tu sngags ni brjod nas su/ /rnal 'byor gnas ni nges ston zhing*/ /zhes dang*/ saṃ pu ṭir yang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon can/ /kun gyi mgon la phyag byas nas/ /bya ba byas pa'i blo chen gyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa bsten par bya/ /zhes nangs par snga bar langs nas bsam pa rnam par dag pa la gnas pas/ slob dpon la spyod pa byed par zhus te/ de yang sdom 'byung las/ ji lta'i de snyed bla ma'i bka'/ /thob nas rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ kyai rdo rjer yang*/ mnar med spangs pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /grub pa'i bla ma mngon phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs shing gnang ba thob nas lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga lus la byugs pa la sogs pa'i rdzas dang*/ go cha gsum sogs lha sngags kyis dag byed byas te/ slob dpon dang yi dam mthong ba na phyag 'tshal zhing rtsa sngags brjod pa yin te/ bzang ngan tha mal du 'dzin pa'i sems spangs nas/ rtsa rgyud las/ slob dpon dpa' bo mthong gyur na/ /sgrub pa pos ni sngags 'di dag /mthong zhing mthong zhing kun tu dga'/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi gsang sngags mchog

/dpa' bo'i yi ge bdun po ni/ /'dzin par gang zhig byed pa ni/ /oṃ dang hūṃ gi khyad par dbye/ /de rnams 'bad de phyag bya zhing*/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thams cad mchod/ /ces gsungs so/ /bdun pa ni/ kha cig 'dod yon mchog dman 'bring gsum rnams sgom bsam gyi sgo nas longs spyod kyang*/ dngos su rten byed ni yul bzang po kho na'o/ /zhes smra ba ni/ legs par ma brtags pa kho na ste/ yul ngan pas bde ba 'phel mi nus snyam par 'dug na yang*/ gang snang thams cad bde ba'i grogs su 'gro ba'i skabs yin pa'i gnad ma shes par snang ste/ gzhan yang rgyud sde rnams las rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems kyis bzang ngan thams cad la ro mnyam du spyod par gsungs shing*/ rgyud 'dir yang*/ rigs rnams kun la spyad bya zhing*/ /bza' min bar ni mi rtog go /de nyid du ni dbyer de med/ /ces dang*/ kyai rdo rjer yang yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog phyir/ /zhen pa tsam du mi bya'o/ /bza' dang bza' min spyod pa dang*/ /de bzhin btung dang btung min nyid/ /bgrod dang bgrod min sngags pa yis/ /rnam rtog nyid du mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas thams cad za bar gsungs pa sogs kyis shes par bya ba yin no/ /brgyad pa ni/ dam tshig brgyad la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshon bya rnams ni 'god mi bya/ /dam tshig can la khro mi bya/ /dbang bskur ba las 'da' mi bya/ /de dang lhan cig bde bar bya/ /zhes go cha las mi 'da' ba'am/ phyag 'tshan mi 'god pa ni bskyed rim gyi spyod pa'i skabs dang*/ dam tshig can gyi mi la mi khro ba dang*/ dbang bskur gyi dam tshig rnams las dmigs bsal ma gtogs mi 'da' ba dang*/ dus bzhir phyag rgya dang lhan cig bde ba bsgoms pa ste gsum dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i tshogs kyi gtsang sbra gsum dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ 'dod pa khro ba 'jigs pa dang*/ /srid pa gti mug nga rgyal spangs/

/rtag tu rtag dang chad pa dang*/ /de bzhin gzhung sgrig bsdu ba spangs/ /zhes dang*/ khrau dang mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ /bstod dang smad pa rnam par spangs/ /rtag tu chags med dga' ba med/ /thams cad thun mong dag tu gnas/ /zhes dang*/ bdag gzhan bdag nyid tshul gyis ni/ /the tshom med par gnas par bya/ / 'dod pa med pa'i kun spyod ni/ /cung zad 'dod pa thams cad spyad/ /ces 'dod pa sogs nyon mongs brgyad spangs pa dang*/ sgrib pa lnga dang nam yang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ rtag chad kyi lta ba dang*/ lung rigs la rtog ge'i spyod pa nam yang mi 'dzin pa dang*/ bstod smad la dga' mi dga' sogs dang*/ gzhan la'ang thun mong ma yin par gces 'dzin gyi sems rnams rtag tu mi 'dre bar bsrung ba dang*/ the tshom mi byed pa dang*/ zhen pa med pa'i sgo nas ci 'dod pa thams cad byed pa dang*/ saṃ pu ṭi dang*/ kyai rdo rje las kyang*/ nges par mngon du lha min gang*/ /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang*/ /'jig pa tsam du mi byed de/ /seng ge'i tshul du rgyu bar bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ sdom 'byung las kyang*/ dgos pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /seng ge ltar spyod rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang la'ang 'jigs pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba rnams/ ji ltar rnyed pa rab tu za/ /zhes pa dang*/ sbyin sreg mchod sbyin dka' thub ldan/ /sngags dang bsam gtan rnam par spangs/ /dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol/ /zhes ji snyed pa nyid longs spyod pa dang*/ /sbyin sreg sogs phyi'i bya ba rnams spangs pa dang*/ tshes grangs dang*/ gza' skar gyi rnam rtog med pa dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig la sogs pa nges par spangs ba dang*/ lus ngag gi sdom pa rnams las nges par grol ba dang*/ gzhan yang ngo tsha dang zhum pa dang tha mal gyi gnyid spong ba ni spyod pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang*/ khyad par 'dir g.yon pa'i kun spyod la gnas pa dang*/ ma dad pa sogs gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa dang*/

gsang spyod kyi skabs su/ sngags dang de bzhin phyag rgya dang*/ / ye shes der ni bsten mi bya/ /zhes shin tu gsang ba dang*/ zhing skyes kyi 'du ba ched du sgrub pa'i skabs su/ pho nya ma gtogs gzhan dag la/ /'dod la rmongs pas 'gro mi byed/ /pho nya mo gzhan rtag thar ba/ /'bad pa yis kyang longs spyod bya/ /zhes sngags skyes la zhen pa ste/ rtag tu bsten pa dang*/ sngags skyes las/ gzhan pa la ni mi bgrod pa'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi brtan pa thob pa'i spyod pa dam tshig ni/ zas thams cad nang gi sbyin sreg dang*/ rtag tu ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dang*/ gang ci mthong ba thams cad rdo rje gsum du shes pas rab gnas byed pa dang*/ ngag sngags su shes pas bzlas pa rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ rtag tu ye shes dang ma bral ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i slob ma rnams la gdam ngag ston pa dang*/ tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyis sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ bdag nyid mchod pas sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed pa dang*/ 'od gsal gyi gnyid nam yang mi spong ba dang*/ grong pa'i chos mi spong ba dang dbang po rnams 'dod yon la mi dgag pa rnams so/ /brtan pa cher thob nas lag pa'i phyag rgya mi 'ching ba dang*/ slob dpon dang brgyud pa'i bla ma ma gtogs sku gzugs la yang phyag mi byed na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor las mi byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ gtsang sbra gsum gyi phan yon dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya ral gri'i so 'dra zhing*/ /dag byed bsod nams 'phel byed yin/ /de bzhin pho nya las 'dres pa/ /sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob/ /bzlas brjod bsam gtan med pa yang*/ /myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ bde ba'i bsod nams chu 'thung ba/ /dag byed sdig pa 'jig byed yin/ /reg pa dang ni smra bas kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing*/ /zhes gsungs te/

spyir pho nya mo dang*/ khyad par spyod pa'i pho nya ni/ sgrib gnyis 'phral du gcod par byed pa'i ral gri'i so dang 'dra zhing*/ sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ bsod nams 'phel bar byed cing*/ bzlas brjod dang ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs pas dngos grub sgrub pa la mi ltos par pho nya mo rnams kyis dngos grub thams cad 'phral du sbyin pa dang*/ chu 'thung ba ste thig le 'dzag med du 'ching ba'i dngos grub thob pas/ rang rgyud kyi dri ma thams cad dag cing 'joms par byed do/ /spyod pa spyad pa 'di ni sbyangs pa las byung ba'i phyag rgya yin kyang*/ rgyud cig bzhin du de yang grol bar 'gyur ba ste/ gsang ba grub pa las kyang*/ tshogs spyod kyi skabs su/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad na ni/ /sdig pa ma lus byang nas ni/ /rig ma dang bcas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ der ma zad/ reg pa dang ni gtam 'dres pa tsam gyis kyang sems can gzhan gyi sdig pa mtha' dag byang bar 'gyur ro/ /rim lnga las kyang*/ rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye shes shing*/ /de nyid bzhi pa la brten te/ /gang zhig rnam gsum la slob pa/ /de ni myur du 'bras thob 'gyur/ /ji ltar shing la me gnas pa/ /ma gtsub par ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub bslab bral bas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'byung mi 'gyur/ zhes rnam gsum ni spyod pa gsum te/ bar 'da' tsam ma gtogs mthong lam dang sangs rgyas thob pa'i mthar thug gi rkyen spyod pa kho na la ltos pa dang*/ dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'ang*/ spyod pa kho na la ltos pa ste/ ma gtsub na 'gal dum tsam la me mi skye ba bzhin/ spyod pa la bslab pa dang bral na/ dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug thob na'ang*/ tshe 'di la mchog mi 'grub la/ des spyod pa spyad na tshe 'dir mi 'grub mi srid pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ dang por gsang ba'i spyod pa bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/

mtshan mo rtag tu gsal bya zhing*/ /nyin par gsang ba nyid du bya/ /byed pa'i ye shes shin tu sba/ /zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rjer yang*/ zla ba gcig tu gsang la spyad/ ces gsungs te/ rang gi sems brtan mi brtan rtag pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan mo dur khrod la sogs pa phyag rgya dang lhan cig la/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas rgyu bar byed de/ 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs pa byas te/ der ye shes cung zad mi brtan na/ re zhig spyod pa mi bya bar/ rnal 'byor nyid brtan pa'i phyir bsgom mo/ /saṃ pu ṭi las kyang*/ de nas byis pa'i rol ba'i rgyu/ bsdus te bsgom la bzhin bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gal te brtan na/ de nyid zla ba gcig tu gom par bya'o/ /der phyag rgya lung ston pa yang 'byung ste/ de nas slob dpon la gnang ba zhus nas/ /'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa spyod de/ spros bcas spros med ci ltar yang*/ 'jig rten phal pa rnams kyi mi shes par rdzu dgos pas/ smyon pa'am/ nal bu'am/ gya tshom pa'i rigs ngan la sogs par rdzus te lung bstan thob pa'i phyag rgya legs par sbyangs na/ zla ba gcig gis skal pa dang ldan par 'gyur bas/ de dang lhan cig spyod pa'am/ sngags skyes dang zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig spyod kyang rung ste/ ji skad du dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma las/ byams pa dka' thub mchog ni tho rangs dus su chang gi don du chang 'tshong khyim du 'gro/ /nyin mtshan dus su mchog gi thugs rjes nya yi don du nya pa rnams kyi tshong 'dus su/ /dgong g-i dus su bud med la 'jug phyir du dga' bas bran mo rnams ky-i khyim du 'gro/ /chang nya bud med rnams kyi dri ma gsum bral a wa dhū tī dmangs rigs cig ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar ma nges pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs pa/ glu gar dang ca co dang bzhad gad dang rtsed mo dang ga zha dang*/ brgyad bkag mchod rgyug sogs tha mal pa rnams la sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs 'byung ba'i bya ba shes dgu cog la 'jug cing*/

yid bzhin du ma 'gyur bar bsgom pa dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang 'byung po'i gtor ma dang lhag ma bor ba sogs za zhing*/ ma sring sogs bgrod bya ma yin pa rnams la bgrod pa sogs/ smad pa'i las sna tshogs pa yang ting nge 'dzin kyi grogs su spyod pa dang*/ 'dir rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pa rnal 'byor par shis par 'gyur ba rnams re zhig mi bya ba yin no/ /bde ba chen po pad+ma badz+ra zhabs kyis/ gsang ba grub par gsungs pa/ rdo rje'i glu ni mi gsal bar/ khams gsum dag tu grags pa yi/ /gzhan dag gsal po nyid du len/ /sna tshogs skad res glu len zhing*/ /sha za bzhin du kun tu khyams/ /zhes dang*/ dman pa'i 'gro ba nyan thos sogs/ /ji ltar gzhan gyis mi rig par/ /de ltar sngags pas bya ba ste/ /bdag nyid sgrub phyir shin tu gsang*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /der rnam par rtog pa mngon du gyur pa rnams nub cing*/ drod 'bring por na 'phos pa na kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya ste/ snga ma la yul la sogs pa la ltos nas slob dpon la gnang ba ma zhus na/ 'dir nges pa zhu ste/ 'di ni 'jig rten rnams kyi mngon du rnal 'byor can du go bar byas te/ ma dad pa zlog par byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs dang bcas nas lta stangs bzhi la sogs pa'i bya bas/ sems can 'dul ba'i don sna tshogs byed pa ste/ 'dir zhing skyes 'du ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rtsol ba med kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drod chen po thob pa na phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa'i 'go 'dzugs pa yin te/ snga ma rnams la yul rkyen gyis tshur cung zad gnod pa yang yod la/ 'di phyir chad ni med do/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa dang po'i skabs 'dir sngar bshad pa'i phyag rgya la brtai+en nas kyang rung*/ nus pas bkug pas kyang rung ste/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo dang*/ /lha dang gnod sbyin yang na ni/

/sa 'og gnas pa'i lha min dang*/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de dag las/ /gang 'dod pa yi rig ma gcig/zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /nye bar bkug ste sgrub byas na/ /'bad pa med pa ci dgos pa'i/ /yo byad thams cad ster bar 'gyur/ /rga dang nad las rnam par grol/ khams gsum sdig bral chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir nges par nus pa chen po rnams thob pas/ chu byung ma dang*/ thig le mchog ma sogs lha mo dgug par sla ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo ma mo chen mo rnams 'gug par bya stai/ de ltar na sbyangs pa las byung ba'i sngags skyes/ zhing skyes sam/ glo bur du dgug pa ste bzhi po de dag gang rung la brten nas rdo rje sems dpa' bskul zhing sgrub pas 'phral nyid du mthong lam mngon du byed do/ /de nas 'phags pa'i sa thob nas kyang*/ gtso bor spyod pa 'di nyid la brten pa ste/ spyod pa phyi ma 'di gnyis tshogs spyod shas che bar 'byung ngo*/ /'dir phyogs las rnam rgyal thog ma ni/ sbyor lam chos mchog gi skabs kyi nye rgyu'i spyod pa de yin te/ so skye'i spyod pa phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ 'phags lam gyi rigs pa'i spang bya la dmigs nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes su bsre bar byed cing zil gyis gnon par mi nus pa'i skabs ni/ 'di nyid la ltos nas bzhag pa'i a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa dang*/ mngon gyur zil gyis gnon byed kyi spyod pa ni kun bzang dang*/ phyis mi skye ba'i chos can du byed pa ni/ 'phags lam gyi nang tshan spyod pa gsum la ltos pa'i phyogs las rnal rgyal yin zhes pa ni/ rje btsun gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhal lung ste/ grub brnyes brgyud pa ma chad pa'i gsung ngag ma nyams pa'o/ / spyir 'phags pa'i spyod pa rnams phyogs las rnam rgyal du 'jog pas/ 'di dang spyod pa gzhan gnyis la gzhi mthun pa ni yod do/

/shes rab kyi rgyud kyi lung drangs yang rung ste/ re zhig pha rgyud kyi lam gyi spyod pa la ni/ zhing rnams su rgyu ba med de/ rgyud de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sngags rgyud gtso bor mi ston pa'i phyir/ khyad par gyi pho nya mo rnams kyi 'du ba ched du sgrub par ma gsungs la/ zhing rnams su rgyu ba'i dgos pa ni de'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thabs 'di yod pas kyang shes rab kyi rgyud khyad par du 'phags te/ lam myur ba yin la/ gang dag ma rgyud rnams su sgyu lus kyi rdzogs rim ston tshul rang gis 'bad pas sgrub nas/ yang sgyu lus gsang 'dus ma gtogs gzhan nas ma bshad pas/ ma rgyud las kyang gsang 'dus ches lhag ces 'gal 'du'i tshig gis de mchog tu sgrub pa dang*/ lha zhal gsum phyag drug pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang 'dus ches zab par 'dod pa sogs/ rgyu mtshan ma rnyed nas snying po med pa'i gtam zar zir mang po gang drag ci drag gi tshul du smras pa yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ a wa dhū tī dang kun bzang gi spyod pa dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal la sogs pa rim par spyod pa'i rnam gzhag 'di la/ 'di dag saṃ pu ṭi'i rgyud don 'chad ma shes pa yin pas/ spyod bsdus la sogs pa'i gzhung don chen po rnams dang 'gal zhes zer ro/ /gzhung chen po dang 'gal zhes zer ba yang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag la zur za ba'i tshig ste/ gzhung chen po 'ga' zhig dang mi mthun pa'i man ngag mi 'thad na/ thogs med sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu dang byams pa'i gzhung chen po dang mi mthun pa'i zla ba grags pa'i gzhung du klu sgrub kyi man ngag bkod pa yang mi 'thad do/ /de klu sgrub kyi gzhung dang mthun snyam na/ dbu ma rtsa ba de re zhig mdo sde rgyan las kyang ches pa ma yin na/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung sho lo ka stong phrag lnga bcu pa las ci zhig che/

des na gzhung chen po de dag la dpags na de chung bas/ gzhung chen po rang khyed la dbang btsan dgos pas/ de las de dbang btsan dgos so/ /'on kyang lugs srol de dang mthun pas chog snyam na/ kho bo cag gi man ngag 'di yang ma rgyud dang mthun pas so/ /theg chen gyi mdo sna tshogs la dgos pa tha dad yod pas dgongs 'grel yang so sor 'gyur ba la 'gal ba med na/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang ma rgyud la mi 'dra ba phran tshegs 'byung ba ci zhig 'gal/ lugs srol tha dad yin no/ /zhes bsam par bya'o/ khyed dag gzhung lugs gdam ngag tu 'char zer ba la/ kho bo cag ya mtshan skye rgyu med de/ snang ba thams cad gdam ngag tu 'char ba'i phyir dang*/ khyed kyi de la ni zhal gdams la zur za ba tsam las snying po mi snang bas so/ /gzhan yang*/ des na rang gis spyod bsdus dang saṃ pu ṭi'i spyod pa'i rnam gzhag sgrig ma shes par/ bde dges kyi rgyu gzhung kun nas/ spyod pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par ma byung ngo zhes mkhas pa rnams khrel bar 'gyur ba'i gtam dbyangs su blang dgos par byung ba yin te/ saṃ pu ṭir gsungs pa'i spyod pa gsum po de'i rnam gzhag la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lugs de 'gog par 'dod cing*/ rang lugs kyang 'di yin rkang tshugs pa 'jog ma shes nas/ man ngag snye ma'i dngos bstan tsam la snang la ma nges kyi zol 'jog byed par snang ngo*/ /de dag la rang lugs 'di yin 'jog rgyu mi snang ba'i phyir/ brgal brtag dngos ni byed rgyu mi snang la/

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ rang lugs 'di ltar 'jog pa ni/ £© saṃ pu ṭi'i sogs rgyud kyi dngos bstan dang shin tu 'byor zhing ma rgyud la mkhas pa'i rgya bod kyi slob dpon rnams kyi bshad pa thams cad kyang 'di'i phyogs su glan pa sha stag yin zhing*/ khyad par 'dus par spyod pa'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus las ma byung ba/ ma rgyud rnams las rgyas par ston pas kha bkang ba'i gsang ba grub par ni 'di kho na bzhin du bshad pa yin no/ /gzhung de ni spyod bsdus las kyang khungs su drangs pas/ khyed dag spyod bsdus gzhung che bar bzhed nas/ gsang ba grub pa de bas chung ba ni ma yin zhing*/ saṃ pu ṭi yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las gzhung chung ba ma yin mod/ khyed dag rim lnga spyod bsdus gzhung chen por 'dod cing bde dges kyi rgyud rnams gzhung chung ba 'dod pa 'di la dpal he ru kas kyang thugs rje'i 'jug pa sbas na/ kho bo cag gis ci zhig bgyid/ kho bo cag gi lugs la ni de dag la mi mthun pa med mod kyi/ khyed ltar na spyod bsdus kyi spyod pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag de saṃ pu ṭi sogs rgyud chen po rnams dang mi mthun pas/ ma dag ces brjod na yang*/ lan ci zhig gdabs bsam dgos so/ /gzhan yang rgyud las gsungs pa kho na gtso che'am/ rjes 'jug slob dpon gyis bshad pa rang gtso che/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rgyud gsungs pa po tshad ma'i skyes bu ma yin par song bas/ de'i dgongs 'grel mkhan de dag kyang rnam par dag pa ga la 'ong*/ 'thad ldan ma yin pa'i gzhung gi don 'grel pa la 'thad ldan 'byung ba ya mtshan no/ /dang po ltar na/ kho bo cag gi 'di yang bde dges sogs kyi dgongs par khas len zhing*/ khyed kyis kyang*/ spyod bsdus sogs dang mthun zhes pa las rang gzhung dang*/ ma mthun pa gcig kyang ston rgyu mi 'dug la/ dngos gnas la yang gzhung dgongs par gsal ba la snyon du med pas so/ khyed dag spyod pa gsum gyi tshogs kyi bya ba spyod bsdus las bshad pa dang*/

rim pas spyod pas rgyu tshul bde dges saṃ pu ṭi sogs nas bshad pa gnyis/ 'bru skyog mang po 'debs par bsam kyang sgrig ma thub pa na rgyud de dag las spyod pa rdzogs pa ma bstan zhes ngo tsha bor ba'i gtam smra dgos byung ba yang spyod pa yin na/ tshogs spyod yin pas khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ ma rgyud mang po las dngos grub 'grub sla bas don du gsang spyod dang tshogs spyod kyi cho ga tsam las gzhan pa'i bya ba thams cad ye shes su bsre tshul mang po byung ba la nges pa ma rnyed pa'i skyon no/ /spyod bsdus dang mi mthun zhes pa ni/ de nas ma bshad pa tsam yin na/ des na sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis lha'i spros bcas kyi rim pa ma gtogs ma bshad pas khyed dag gsang 'dus kyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor byed pa yang mi rigs shing*/ der byed par bshad pa 'dir ni mi byed pa sogs 'ga' zhig snang ngo snyam na/ der kha cig tu tshogs khang byed par bshad pas/ de ltar mi byed pa'i yul chen rnams su rgyu ba'i spyod pa ma rgyud phal cher nas gsal bar bshad pa 'di yang spyod bsdus sogs gzhung chen po dang 'gal bas mi 'thad ces zer ram/ yul chen gyis cha gang du sleb par tshogs khang kho na byed ces smra/ tshig zin de rnams mi mthun kyang*/ don la de yang rung snyam na/ kho bo cag gi 'di yang*/ tshig zin la spyod bsdus nas ma bshad kyi don la spyod bsdus kyi'ang dgongs pa yin no/ / yang kho bo cag gi lugs 'di 'gog byed rgya gar pa'i lung dang khyed nyid kyi rigs pa da dung yod na drangs shig kho bos theg par bya'o/ /des na rang gis legs par ma sbyangs pas rkang nas tshugs pa'i gtam sha stag sgrogs pa la mi 'dzem par ma zad/ lung rigs ci yang med pa'i gtam rang khyab 'ba' zhig gis dgag pa ltar snang re byas nas/ skyes bu dam pa rtags mngon du gyur pa gzhung lugs la shin tu byang ba rnams la skur pa btab pa'i sdig bsags pa la khyed la khye ci yod/

gsum pa la/ spros bcas spros med zhar byung shin tu spros med de gsum las/ dang po la/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ der 'dod yon la ji ltar rol pa/ pho nya 'du ba'i grub tshul gsum las/ dang po la gnas ni/ mnyam sbyor las/ yang na srid pa gsum dag gam/ /skyed mos tshal la sogs par sgrub/ /der ni dang por gdan bshams te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gnyis kyi dang po gnas ni/ rang gi gnas khang ngam skyed mos tshal la sogs par tshogs kyi khang pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ sgo dang rta babs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i rim pa dang por tshang bang gi yo byad dang*/ der mi rnams 'dugaganyis par glu gar dang rol mo'i yo byad rnams bzhagagasum par rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig spyod pa spyod pa'i gnas bya'o/ /yang na sa'i khang pa rwa bas bskor ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas kyang rung ste/ der chu tshod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bris te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gnas rnams su/ 'jam zhing reg na bde ba'i ras la sogs pa la sna tshogs pad+ma'i gzugs bya zhing*/ mi ro'i gzugs brnyan la sogs pa gdan gyi khyad par gzhan yang rung ste/ kyai rdo rjer tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor skabs su/ de la gdan du rtag pa ni/ /ro'i gzugs brnyan dgu dang ni/ /yang na stag gi pags pa dang*/ /dur khrod ras ni de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la ni/ ro ras sam ro gdan dngos sam stag gi pags pa kho nas kyang rung la/ dbus dang phyogs la g.yas bskor gyis mi ba glang khyi rta glang po rnams kyi pags gdan nam/ de dag bris pas kyang rung zhing*/ yang na kun spangs kyi gnas dur khrod la sogs pa rnams yang rung ste/ kyai rdo rje las/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang*/ /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dag/yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu za/ /zhes gsungs so/

/gal te zhing rnams nges med du spyod pa zhig yin na/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'di lo zlar lan re sogs ci rigs par spyod cing*/ rnga dang glu gar la sogs bya ba'i spros pa thams cad dang bcas bzhin du 'dod yon la rgya cher spyod pa yin gyi/ tshogs khang dang gdan la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin rgyun du sgrub mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs pa ni/ phyi ma 'di la phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas te yul dang yul du rgyu zhing*/ bza' btung ji ltar rnyed pa thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lor byed pa yin no/ /'di la'ang gang du sdod pa'i sa phyogs der/ lha so so'i gnas su phyag rgya rnams 'god pa phyogs mthun par ni dgos te/ kyai rdo rjer yang*/ phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu yang*/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams 'god/ /ces rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i rig ma brgyad 'god par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /des na gang dag mnyam sbyor ma gtogs ma rgyud las spros bcas kyi dkyil 'khor ma bshad par sems pa ni/ 'di tsam la yang ma brtags pa yin te/ 'di tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs yin pas/ mi 'dren snyam na/ mnyam sbyor gyi de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes tshogs 'khor kho na'i skabs yin gyis/ tshogs 'khor phal pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig gi skabs su ni ma yin no/ /gnas de dag tu rnal 'byor pa rig mar bcas pa lha'i chas su 'jug dgos te/ de yang mnyam sbyor las/ de na rnam pa 'phrul pa mdzad/ khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin srog dang rtsa las byung*/ /rang gi lha la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /grub pa'i phyag rgyas rab tu bskor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i tshe/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i khams sam pags pa'am/ rtsa shing sogs las byung ba'i gdong gi 'bag bya ba'am/ kha dog bsgyur ba sogs bya ste/ lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan yang rgyas par byed na ma 'chol par 'dzin par bya'o/

/ma grub na rigs mthun bsdus te/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'am/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la spyi'i phyag mtshan yin pas thams cad la cang te'u thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ gsum gyis kyang rung ngo*/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dril bu dang*/ rdo rje thod pa sogs kyis rung bar yang mngon/ lha zhal phyag mtshan gyi gtso bo 'dzin pa rdo rje gur gyi sangs rgyas gar gyi skabs su mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad pa de ltar yang rgyas pa'i skabs su'ang bya'o/ /kun tu rgyu zhing spyod pa ni/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang*/ stag lpags ro ras gyon pa sogs dang*/ dbyug pa cang te'u sogs lha'i phyag mtshan ci rigs pa bzung bas kyang chog go /des na gzhan dang gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa la 'jug pa yang 'di'i rim pas shes par 'gyur bas/ re zhig 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang du byas nas/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i chas kyis dbus su gnas pa dang*/ phyogs phyogs mtshams rnams su pad+ma can la sogs pa'i lus kyi dbye ba'am/ kha dog gam/ nyon mongs sam/ sems kyi mthu'i khyad par ram/ me tog phog pa'i lha'am/ mos pa'i khyad par gyis lha'i gnas su 'god tshul te/ dper na/ rgyu mtshan phyi ma bzhi po gang rung gis rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs bde chen 'khor lo'i lha gnas dang*/ rdo rje rigs thugs 'khor dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs gsung 'khor dang*/ 'khor lo'i rigs sku 'khor dang*/ las kyi rigs dam tshig 'khor lo'i gnas su bkod nas/ nang tshan du de dag la rigs bzhi tshang na/ pad+ma can ma rnams shar phyogs dang*/ glang chen ma rnams byang phyogs dang*/ dung can ma rnams nub phyogs dang*/ ri mo can ma rnams lho phyogs su 'god pa lta bu ste/ rigs sogs 'jog byed rnam pa lnga po de dag so so so sor thams cad tshang na mchog yin kyang de dkon pas/ cha shas re re'i rgyu mtshan du byas nas lha gnas so sor 'jog pa dgos so/ /lus kyi khyad par gzhan yang*/

bud med dang ni skyes pa yi/ /gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi 'khor los 'gyur/ /dpag med mgon gyi 'dam skyes nyid/ /rin chen 'byung gi rin chen nyid/ /las kyi rigs ky-i ral gri nyid/ /ces sha mtshan gyi khyad par yang gsungs pas/ kha dog ni rdo rje la nag po/ rnam snang la dkar po/ rin chen la ser po/ pad+ma la dkar dmar/ don yod la sngo sangs sogs so/ /nyon mongs kyi khyad par ni/ zhe sdang shas che ba mi bskyod pa'i rigs yin pas so/ /sems kyi mthu'i khyad par ni/ blo brtan pa rnam snang*/ snying phod che ba mi bskyod pa/ longs spyod spel ba'i 'khos che ba rin 'byung*/ gzhan gyis yid sgyur ba dang*/ bslu ba dang*/ 'khrul par byed pa la mkhas pa ni 'od dpag med/ khyim las dang*/ zhing las dang*/ tshong la sogs pa las kyi mtha' la brtson pa ni don grub gyi rigs so/ /de ltar rnal 'byaur ma sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ spyod pa'i tshogs kyi lam/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yang lha grangs ma nges pa mtha' yas pa yod pa'i phyir/ spros bcas kyi tshogs dkyil la grangs kyang sna tshogs 'byung ngo*/ /yang nus pa rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor pa yod na/ 'khor kyi lha mo rnams kyi gnas su/ rigs kyi dbye bas de 'god do/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyung zhing rnam 'byaur ma mang na/ lha re re'i gnas su de dag du ma 'god du rung zhing*/ yang na lha mo brgyad la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshul du 'god pa yang rung ste/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su bud med lnga'am/ dgu'am/ bcu gsum mam/ so bdun nam/ rnal 'byor pho mo drug cu rtsa gnyis sam/ ji ltar rigs par mtha' yas pa'i bar du yang 'gyur te/ dper na/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dang mthun pa'i bkod pa yang yod do/ /yang bud med lhag por gyur pa rnams pi waṃ dang gling bu dang cang te'u

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ rnga bo che dang £© rdza rnga me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dri chab rnams thogs pa'i lha mo brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'god pa la sogs pa ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /ma lhag na sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis mchod pa de dag 'bul zhing*/ de yang nges par ma grub na ci rigs ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /des na gang dag spros bcas la phyag rgya lha grangs dang mnyam par dgos zhes pa dang*/ phyag rgya dgu'i lnga spyod kyi spyod pa la/ spros med kyi khyab pa sogs smra ba ni/ lha dgu dang lnga'i dkyil 'khor mi srid par 'dod na ni mi rung ngo*/ /'di yang spyod bsdus kyi dngos bstan rgyud thams cad la khyer ba'i skyon no/ /yang sngon rim gnyis sgom pa'i tshe/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa bsgoms pas kyang*/ spros bcas spyod pa'i skabs lha lnga yan chad kyi tshogs dkyil dang*/ rang dang rtsa ba'i phyag rgya gcig pu gtso bo yab yum du bsgom pa/ bud med lhag ma mchod pa'i lha mor bsgom pa/ lhan skyes kyi dkyil 'khor kyang rung bas/ cho ga tshogs mchod brda lan chas 'jug sogs kyis spros bcas su 'jog gi tshogs dkyil mang nyung gis ni 'jog mi thub bo/ /kun 'dar gyi spyod pa la grong du rgyu ba na lha'i chas 'jug kyang ji lta ba byed pa dang*/ smyon par brdzu ba sogs bag tsam mi 'grib pas/ nges pa med pa'i chas kyis lha'i chas 'jug tu don gyis 'gro ba tsam byed de/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ 'bras bu sna tshogs do shal sogs/ /'ol ma zil la sogs pas spras/ /zhes dang*/ ro bsreg thal bas rnam par brgyan/ dur khrod phru chag thogs nas ni/ /zhes pa dang*/ gdan bzhi dang gsang ba grub pa sogs su yang de ltar mang du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sgom bsam gsum po gang rung gis sgo nas bskyed pa la/ bskyed rim gyi spyod pa'i skabs ni gtso 'khor thams cad sgrub thabs kyi rim pas dmigs pa mthun pas bskyed pa yin zhing*/

rdzogs rim gyi skabs su ni skad cig gis bskyed pa ste/ longs spyod thams cad byin gyis brlabs te/ ji ltar tshogs ky-i 'khor lo'i cho ga bzhin du bza' btung rnams nang gi sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor phung khams skye mched thams cad du bde ba chen pos yongs su khyab par byas la lhan cig spyod pa dang spyod pa'i rjes su spyod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi nang nas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin blang nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes mos pa brtan po bskyed pa ste/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas a lir ga nā dang*/ tsum+pa na dang*/ tsu ṣa ṇa dang*/ na ga pra ha na dang*/ ma ra da na dang*/ ku ca gra ha na ste/ rnam pa drug gi rjes su chags pa bskyed cing*/ sī ta ka ra dang*/ ko ki la dang*/ bung ba'i sgra te si ta kyi sgra byung ba de srid du t+yai de gu li sbyor bas/ ā li kā li dang*/ myos gdugs dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ dung can dang*/ rtsa gsum yang dag par bskul ba'i bar du byas te/ rang gi lha'i 'dug steng sogs la gnas pas do la dang*/ sū rtsi dang kur+pa ra la sogs pa sbyor thabs dang bcas te snyom par zhugs pa na/ dga' bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ bde ba chen po la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ de las langs pa na snang ba thams cad sgyu ma ltar sgom zhing*/ gang snang lha skur 'char bar byas te/ de dag gi bar du yid gzhan du 'gyur ba med par rol rtsed rgya chen po dag byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas gang la sogs pa'i rigs dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig tu gtso bos phyag rgya ston pa dang*/ rig mas phyag rgya de'i lan ston pa dang*/ de bzhin du phyag dang phyag gi lan dang*/ mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lan dang*/ glu dang glu'i lan dang*/ gar dang gar gyi lan dang*/ lus kyi brda dang*/ ngag gi brda la sogs pa/ gzhan zlos gar/

rol mo dang*/ 'dug steng dang gar gyi nyams dgu la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa bsten pas dbang po rnams brtas par bya'o/ /'di ni rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin bdag nyid mchod pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs sras bcas dang*/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma/ /brtan pa dag dang g.yo ba dang*/ /spun dang sdug pa mchod pa ste/ /la gnas zla ba 'dus pa la'o//spun dang bu dang lhan cig tu//bde dang sdug bsngal kun 'byung yin/ /zhes dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya sgrub pa pos/ /mchod pa nyid la rab tu 'jug/'di las gzhan pa'i mchog ma de/ /bstan chos nyid du nges pa yin/ /pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ /sgrub pa po ni dngos grub brtson/ /rigs sngags phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /zas la rtag tu spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor kun la 'jug pa yis/ /sgrub po lags par mnyam bzhag bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag nyid mchod pas 'dod pa'i lha thams cad mnyes pa dang*/ brtan g.yo ste rtsa khams rlung thams cad brtas par byed pa ni/ spun te rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sdug pa stai rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas te zla ba 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa 'di yin te/ thams cad bde ba chen po la lhan cig spyod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal te lhan cig tu zhing du 'gro ba dang*/ bya rtsol gyis ngal bar byed pa'o/ /bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gis ni/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi don 'di skabs kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams skyid mnyam sdug mnyam gyi don lta bur bzhed do/ /rig sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i zas te longs spyod rnams la rtag tu spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ni sbyor ba ste/ drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ dga' ba spel ba'i yan lag glu gar rom mo sogs kun la 'jug pa dang*/ bde stong dang lha sku la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas 'jug go zhes pa'i don te/ des na bde mchog tu yang tshogs dkyil shin tu gsal mod kyi/

tshogs khang la sogs pa gsal bar ma bstan pa ni/ rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi spros bcas spros med gnyis la zhing rnams su rgyu ba gtso che bas yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gcig tu gnas pa dang*/ zhing du rgyu ba'i spyod pa gang yin yang rung ste/ rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi pho nya bskul ba ni nges par dgos so/ /spyir gnyis char la yang de 'byung mod kyi/ yul rnams su rgyu ba pho nya'i 'du ba thob pa ches sla ba yin te/ ji srid du lhan skyes kyi 'du ba ma thob bar de srid du/ zhing skyes dang*/ khyad par sngags skyes kyi rdzu 'phrul la rgyang ring thung gi bye brag yod pas so/ /rang sems shin tu dag pa la ni/ mkha' khyab kyi lus can lhan skyes rnams kyi 'du ba thob pa'i phyir de la ni gnas pa dang*/ rgyu ba la phan yon 'dra'o/ /pho nya gsum bskul ba'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de ni rol par yang dag gnas/ sgrub pa dag dang nye ba'o/ /pho nya rnams ni yang dag bskul/ /zhes pa dang*/ mchog dbus tha ma lhan cig dgugs/ /de ltar rdzas ni rnam nges yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyod pa las byung ba yang dag par bstan pas/ sngags skyes rnams de'i lus la 'jug ste bde ba chen po'i rjes su mchod pa len par byed cing de mnyes nas dngos su 'du ba ster/ de dngos su bstan pa na/ des kyang gnas sogs rigs mthun pa'i zhing skyes rnams la gsol ba 'debs shing sgrub pa po 'di rjes su bzung bar mdzod cig ces so/ /de ltar bskul ba des sngags skyes ma'i lus la zhing skyes ma 'jug ste/ der bde ba chen po'i mchod pa len zhing mnyes pa na/ rang gi 'du ba dngos su ster bar byed do/ /de bsten pa na des rang gi rigs kyi bdag mo'i lhan skyes ma rnams bskul bar byed do/ /de'i lus la lhan skyes mas byin gyis rlobs shing zhugs nas mchod pa len/ mnyes pa na/ lhan skyes kyi 'du ba mngon sum du ster te/

de nyid du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /pho nya gsum gyi mchod pa len pa las bdag nyid la bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba dang*/ sgrib pa zad pa la phyi ma phyi ma stobs ches che ba dang*/ pho nya gsum dang phrad na dngos grub che chung gsum de nyid du 'grub kyang bsod nams dman pa la las kyi 'ching ba las gzhan pa'i 'du ba mi 'byung bas 'phel zad byed pa'i thabs de ltar dgos pa yin no/ /dper na bcud len chen po ni sus bsten kyang 'ja' lus su 'gro ba yin mod kyi/ nus pa dang skal pa med pas mi rnyed pa bzhin no/ /pho nya'i lam la zhugs pa rnams ni/ sngags skyes kyi 'du ba spyod pa'i thog ma nas 'byung zhing*/ rnal 'byor pa lam 'ba' zhig sgom pa rnams kyis ni/ spyod pa'i thog mar sbyangs pa'i rig ma la brten nas sngags skyes bskul bas/ phyis 'du ba thob par 'gyur ba las/ thog ma nas thob pa myur zhing*/ lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya yin yang*/ sngags skyes sogs yin pas ma khyab ste/ pho nya gsum ni sbyangs mi dgos pa las/ de ni sbyangs par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gis ni rtsa rgyud las/ bdag gi pho nya mo kun 'gro/ /pho nya mo de kun 'grub ste/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang*/ /tsum+pa na dang rtag pa 'khyud/ /rnal 'byor gnas ni khyad par nyid/ /ji srid rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad dngos grub byed par bshad/ /bde can kun la sbyin bya yin/ /gzhan du nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams legs par phye zin to/ /gong du bshad pa'i dam tshig brgyad po rnams kyang*/ spyod pa'i skabs 'dir ches gtso bor spyod pa yin te/ dam tshig brgyad po de dag gi mi mthun phyogs phra mos kyang ma gos pa dang*/ bsgrub par bya ba thams cad la yang lhag par sbyangs pas/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyis sgrub pa po de la gus pas ste shin tu mnyes pas/ dngos su dngos grub ster bar byed do//rtsa rgyud las/

khwa gdong la sogs brgyad 'di dag/mos dang dad pa 'phel byed pa/ /rtag par dngos grub rnams kyi rgyu/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang ba'o/ /zhes te/ dam tshig brgyad bsrung ba ni ma mo rnams kyi dngos grub stsol ba'i rgyu khyad par can te 'di'i dam tshig du khwa mo dang*/ 'ug pa mo dang*/ khyi mo dang*/ phag mo sogs dud 'gro mo la yang gus par bya'o/ /zhes bla ma sngar rabs pa rnams kyi man ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ mang ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ rig ma gcig kho na yang rung ste/ chas 'jug dang dkyil 'khor dang*/ tshogs khang dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba rnams ci rigs su spyod kyang*/ snga ma las ches nyung ba dang*/ res 'ga' byed la phal cher mi byed pa sogs kyi spros pa nyung ngu tsam byed pa'o/ /'di ni gnod sbyin mo dang nags tshal gyi lha la sogs pa mngag gzhug tu sgrub ste/ des yo byad sbyor ba'ang yod de/ ji skad du/ sgrub pa po ni blo brtan pas/ nags tshal dag tu bsod snyoms bslang*/ kha zas bzang po ster ba dag /skrag nas de la ster bar 'gyur/ /'das na rdo rje gsum bdag nyid/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje ma rungs 'gyur/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /lha ma yin nam mi yang rung*/ /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs sbyangs/ /zhes 'dus par gsungs shing*/ rdo rje gur las kyang de ltar bshad pas so/ /'di ni spyod pa gsum char la 'byung bar mngon no/ /spyod pa phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs 'dir ni/ nags tshal gyi 'bras bu sogs za zhing spyod pa spyod pa'ang yod/ 'dus pa las/ sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras bu yi/ /bza' dang bcas pa spyad par bya/ /'on tang myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba cung zad ma tshang ba yang yod do/ /gsum pa la/ spyod tshul ngos bzung ba dang*/ de'i dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni ri bo dang chu ngogs dang dur khrod dang rang gi khang pa sogs gang yang rung ba gnod sby-in mo sogs mngag gzhug tu sgrub pa'am/

bsod snyoms sam/ gzhan gyis kha zas sbyor ba yang rung ste/ g.yeng ba thams cad spangs shing*/ til 'bru tsam yang yongs su 'dzin pa'i blo dor nas/ rang gi snying kha nas phyung ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba lhur len pa yin la/ khyad par rdzogs rim pas ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal nyid rtag tu sgom pa yin no/ /'di la bhu su ku'i spyod pa zhes bya ste/ bhu ni bhuñdza na ste za ba/ su ni su ta ne ta gnyid log pa/ ku ni ku ṭi sa ra ste bshang gci'i phyir 'chag pa ste/ lus 'tsho ba'i zas tsam za ba dang*/ 'od gsal gyi gnyid log pa dang*/ 'chag par 'gro ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i don no/ / 'dir gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom par gsungs pa gnyid rang babs su byung ba tsam 'od gsal du 'jug pa ni ma yin te/ de ni skabs 'di'i spyod pa gzhan gnyis la yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na spyod pa gzhan gnyis la phyi'i phyag rgya bsten pa'i dod 'dir gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom pa yin pas rtag tu gnyid log par byed pa yin no/ /des na bskyed rim gyi shin tu spros med la ni bhu su ku'i spyod pa zhes mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chags can 'dod chags kyi spyod pa tsam po 'di ni/ bskyed rim gyi shin tu spros med kho na yin la/ brtson 'grus can tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i spyod pa ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyid bsre dang bcas pa gong du bstan pa ste/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dngos nyid dang*/ bar dor 'da' ba'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal mthong ba'i lam la 'jug pa de nyid 'chi ba dang bsre ba dang*/ drod thob nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal la rtse gcig tu dril bas/ tshe 'dir sgyu lus ma thob par/ bar dor thob nas de'i rten la zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus khyad par can zhig grub pa'i rten la 'da' ba'i lugs la yang rung ste/

gnyid dang bsre ba skye ba brgyud nas 'tshang rgya ba'i spyod pa dang*/ sa bcu'i bar mdo lugs kyis bgrod nas/ sngags la 'jug pa nye rgyu btsan thabs kyi spyod pa ste/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang phyogs mthun gsum mo/ /bar pa de gnyis ni spyod pa dngos ma yin zhing*/ phyi ma ni/ las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa yin yang shin tu spros med kyi phyogs su bsdus te dmigs pa yin no/ /'di ni mtshon byed tsam ste 'tshang rgya ba'i nye rgyu'i spyod pa thams cad do/ /de dag gi mtha' cung zad dpyad na des na spyir gong du bshad pa ltar 'od gsal ma thob na/ sgyu lus thob kyang skye ba len par bshad pa/ gtso bor bar do skye srid dang 'dra ba la dgongs pa yin yang*/ bar do nyid du sgyu lus thob pa la/ skye srid len pa'i rigs can yang yod pas/ 'od gsal ma thob na zhes brtag pa mthar bzung yin gyi/ spyir de 'dra mi srid de/ sgyu lus thob pa tshe 'dir 'od gsal ma thob kyang*/ 'chi ba'i tshe don gyi 'od gsal mi thob mi srid pas so/ /des nas don 'grub rab tu mi 'byung ba mi srid kyang*/ rab tu ma byung na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes pa dang 'dra zhes zer ba ni/ bar dor sgyu lus 'grub pa'i skabs yod pa tsam gyi don la yang zhib tig ma byung ba ste/ rang gis kyang snang ba'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa spyod pa spyod rgyu ma byung bar shi ba de skye ba brgyud nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rdzogs rim par ngos bzung ba brjod pa'i gtam ste/ sgyu lus thob na skye ba mi len pas khyab pa dang ci phyir mi 'gal lo/ /rang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i lugs la 'gal ba rags pa de tsam yod pa'i ma tshang yang ma rigs par/ kho bos gsung rab la lta rtog dang thos bsam byas pa na/ rgya bod du nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams la yang gsung rab kyi gnad ma go ba'i 'khrul pa mang po yod ces sems tsam gyi lugs 'dzin pa'i pan+ṭi ta chen po rnams dang*/

dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams dang*/ khyad par mai tri pa dang*/ a bha ya sogs dang*/ bod kyi snga phyir byon pa'i mkhas grub rnams la sdang smra mi bzad pa ste/ mdo las/ byis pa gang zhig byas pa'o zhes/ /shes pa de 'dir mkhas pa'o/ /byis pa gang gis mkhas sems pa/ /de ni shin tu byis par brjod/ / ces blun po gang rang blun por shes pa ni cung zad mkhas pa yin la/ rang blun po yin yang mkhas par nga rgyal byed pa ni shin tu blun no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsam dgos so/ /'dir sgyu lus thob kyang skye ba len par gsungs pa'i gzhung don dngos ni/ bar srid len pa nyid yin te tshe 'dir sgyu lus thob pa'i skabs kyi spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub pa'i gang zag gis spyod pa spyad pas/ khams phra rags kyi thim tshul re re la brten nas 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa 'khor mor 'byung bas spyod bsdus su spyod pa'i skabs su khams phra rags thim tshul gsungs pa yin la/ 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i ltas kyi rmi lam rnams 'byung ba dang*/ lus phra yang gi yon tan brgyad ldan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa shas che'o/ /bskyed rim gyi spyod pa'i skabs su dngos grub dngos la sbyor ba ni shin tu spros med kyis chog pa yod kyang*/ spros bcas dang spros med gang rung zhig nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa yin/ shin tu spros med la/ lus mtsho ba tsam gyis zas kyis chog par bshad pa la/ 'ga' zhig dka' thub la brten par 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig lus brtan par gyur pa'i zas dgos zhes smra ba ni/ gnyis char gyis gnad ma longs bar snang ste/ spyod pa spyi'i mtshan nyid du/ 'ga' zhig dka' thub spangs nas 'dod yon bsten pa yin pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyas 'byung mchog thob pa'i skabs zas kyang za dgos pa'i nges pa med so/ /des na spyod pa gzhan gnyis la longs spyod mang po don gnyer yod kyang 'di la lus 'tsho ba tsam gyi yo byad las lhag po ched gnyer med do/

/dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug gi sgrub byed kyi spyod pa la yang*/ gtso bor gsum po gang spyod kyang*/ spros bcas spros med gang rigs shig nges par spyod dgos la/ rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub phan chad du ni/ spyod pa gsum gang la brten kyang rung ste/ dbang po rnon po la shin tu spros med myur ba dang 'bring po la spros med dang*/ tha ma la spros bcas so/ /'di la dgongs nas 'gos ches po/ shes rab che chung gsum go zlog tu sbyor bar mdzad pa yang 'gal ba med do/ /snang ba'i rtogs pa skyes nas spyod pa la ma brten par sgyu lus thob pa yang yod na/ spyod pa dang po gnyis nges par spyod dgos pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ spyod pa ma spyad na las rgya la brten nas de 'grub kyang*/ spyod pa spyad phyin sangs rgyas pa'i nye rgyu yin na ma gtogs shin tu spros med 'ba' zhig yin na las rgya nges par spong dgos pa yin pas snang ba thob nas shin tu spros med 'ba' zhig gis de sgrub par mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /yang spyod pa'i skabs su drag shul sgrub pa 'byung ste/ phyag rgya'i pad+mar gnas pa'i lha la phur bus btab pas dngos grub ster ba'i don du gnad la 'bor zhing bskul ba'o/ /de yang spyod pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa shin tu zla ba drug tu bya zhing*/ des ma 'grub na lan gnyis des ma 'grub na lan gsum du bskyar bas 'grub/ des kyang ma 'grub na drag shul sgrub pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsad pa'i cho ga byas pas nges par 'grub par gsungs pa/ bod la la dag rdzogs rim par 'dod/ la la dag bskyed rim gyi spyod pa bzhed/ nges par bya ba ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon po bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa can sngon bskyed rim mthar byung ba zhig gis yi dam gyi lha bskul ba'i spyod pa ste/ bskyed rim la gtso bor brten pa'i khyad par cig ste/

lha de dang mjal bas 'phral du mchog 'grub pa ste 'di zur pa zhig go /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ spyod pa'i go rim/ 'bras bu/ cho ga gsum las/ dang po ni/ bde bas gnyis snang rags pa 'gog pa la brtson pa la spangs pa zhes brtags pa'am/ 'phags lam gyi kun 'dar mnyam bzhag tu re zhig spangs pa'ang yin pas de kun 'dar gyi spyod pa dam pa ste/ bzang po ni thog ma spyod cing*/ rdzun dang log g.yem dang tshig rtsub sogs ci byas pa thams cad/ rgyu'i dus su byang chub kyi sems dang*/ dgos pa khyad par can rang gis byang chub myur du 'grub pa'i tshul mthong ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dus na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol du song*/ 'bras bu'i dus na rang gi ye shes cher 'phel ba gzhan don du 'gyur bas na/ de dag kyang sdig pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i dge ba mchog bya ba bzang po 'ba' zhig yin na/ de la nam yang nyes spyod mi srid pas/ yul dus gnas skabs kun tu bzang po 'ba' zhig tu spyod pas kun bzang spyod pa ste bar du byed de/ de yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ g.yem pa rnams la g.yem par 'gyur/ khro ba rnams la khro ba'i mchog/zhi ba rnams la zhi ba'i mchog/drag shul can la drag pos gnon/ /zhes gang 'dul du spyod cing*/ de ni dge ba mnyam pa nyid du mthong ba zhes bya ste/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ mkhas pas 'di dag rnam par spangs/ zhes pas blang dor med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'o/ /de dag spyad pas dngos grub rab 'byams thob pa'o/ /drod chen po thob nas ni don du 'gyur na/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa bya ste/ bdag nyid 'jigs pa dang dogs pa med pas bdud dang mi ma yin dang mu stegs sogs/ mi dang smra ba dang*/ sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad pas zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dngos grub dang rdzu 'phrul gyi sprul pas gzhan gyi don zad mi shes par sgrub par byed pa tha mar spyod pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ste/

spyod pa gsum po de yang nang tshan spros bcas sogs gsum gsum du dbye bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag spyad pas gong ma'i lam mthong sgom sogs dang*/ sa bcu gong 'og rnams thob bo/ /gsum pa ni/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas rim pa bzhi pa mthar phyin pa byed pa ste/ dngos ni rim pa bzhi pa mthar phyin pa byed pa'o/ /da ni de dag kun gy-i grub don bshad na/ 'dod 'jug brten slob drod tshar nyul ba yi/ /spyod pa 'di gsum rig spyod phyogs mthun yin/ /kun 'dar kun bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal gsum/ /skye 'phags so sor bstan na tha dad de/ /'phags pa'i gsum ka'ang phyogs las rnam rgyal yin/ /spros bcas sogs gsum bya ba'i khyad par te/ /dbang po gsum la mthu yang so sor phye/ /rnal 'byor lam pa dang po gnyis bsten dgos/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /'dod yon ji lta 'dod pa la ma bkag par longs spyod pas bde bas/ bde stong gi ye shes brtan por gyur pa'i rgyun gong 'phel du byed cing*/ gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya spyod sna tshogs pa dang*/ gnas dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus mi 'dra ba sna tshogs par dga' ba dang*/ skyo ba dang*/ ngo mtshar dang*/ rnam g.yeng dang*/ brtse sems dang*/ chags sdang sogs nyon mongs dang*/ sems kyi 'gyur ba'i khyad par sna tshogs skye 'gyur gyi yul thams cad nges med du spyod lam sna tshogs pas bsten zhing*/ bde stong dang lha sku'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa'i rtsa ba las skad cig kyang ma yengs par sems kyi rtsal 'gyur ba de dag tu cung zad snang ba ji snyed byung ba thams cad/ rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i bde stong gi dbyings su bsre ba'o/ /drod chung ngu skyes pa dang*/ 'di skabs kyi bde stong shin tu brtan pa dang*/ dga' ba'am snang ba'i rtogs pa skyes pa rnams don gcig ste/ mchog kho na'i dus su rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa byed pa'i skabs kyi thog ma'o/

/rtaugs pa de dag dang ldan pas phyag rgya sna tshogs pa'i longs spyod bsten pa na/ sngar pho nya'i lam gyi dus las ches lhag pa'i rtsa thig le rlung sems te bzhi po de dag tshul mthar phyin pa 'byung ngo*/ /rig ma'i khyad par mang po dang*/ spyod lam sna tshogs pa bsten pa dag ni/ sems kyi dri ma phra mo zhen pa'i tshul gyi gnas pa rnams mngon gyur du slong nas bde stong gi dbyings su spyad de dag par byed pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di grub bo/ /mthar thug pa yang 'di la ltos pas/ dam pa kha cig yongs su grags pa'i rig spyod kyis spangs bya rags pa las phra mo spong mi nus/ rig spyod khyad par 'phags pa tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yin zhes gsungs pa tshul khṛms kyi sdom pa yang dge slong gi sdom pa la ngos 'dzin par mdzad do/ /dgos pa gzigs pas gsung pa yin snang ba'i phyir/ spyir mi 'gal mod kyang*/ don la ni mi rung ste/ de lta na mi'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom rnams kyang zla phyed dam zla ba drug tshun chad kyis sangs rgyas thob dgos par 'gyur te/ 'phags lam gyi rig spyod la nyin mtshan rtag tu gnas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang 'di'i lugs la dam bca' 'ba' zhig lu gu rgyud du byed pa ma gtogs/ lung rigs kyi sgrub byed sna gcig kyang med pa dang*/ rang nyid kyis chos gzhan du mi zab pa 'dir zab ces thun mong gi lam thams cad zab par mdzad cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa stong nyid/ phra thig phyag rgya'i lam la sogs pa mi zab ces gsungs pas/ mdo sngags kyi zab khyad phyin ci log tu khas len dgos te/ zab tshad mdo lugs nas rtsal du bton pa dang*/ mi zab tshe snga nas rtsal du bton par song ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang de lta na ni phar phyin theg pa'i lam sangs rgyas thob pa la myur bar 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ni rang gi gzhung las kyang bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs thogs par bshad la/ sngags la tshe gcig la grub pa 'o skol gnyis ka la grub pa ma yin nam/

mthar gtugs na theg chen gyi mdo rnams las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nyid ston la/ de tsam du so sor thar pa rig bdun mi ston pa dang*/ rig spyod ni sangs rgyas kyi nye rgyu yin par bzhed pas/ theg chen las kyang nyan thos kyi sde snod zab ces bya bar song zhing*/ de zab pa ni lta ci smos/ de dag tu byang chub sems dpa'i lam yang rdzogs par ma bstan par grub bo/ /gzhan yang*/ dge slong mchog 'dzin can rig spyod kyi chos nyan pa'i snod tsam yang ma yin par gsungs pa yin te/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron mar lung drangs par yang*/ gang zhig dge slong dngos gnas dang*/ /gang yang rtog la dga' ba'i mi/ /mi gang rgan por gnas gyur pa/ /de la de nyid mi ston zhes pa'i de nyid kyang spyod pa yin par gsungs shing*/ de nyid las/ bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu mchog la mngon par dga' ba rnams la/ nyan thos dang mdo sde'i tshul dang ldan pa'i spyod pa ma gsungs te zhes pa nas/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i spyod pa dka' ba rnams kyis dus ring pos byang chub tshol bar byed mod kyi/ 'on kyang thob par mi byed do/ /zhes gsungs pas shin tu gnod pa yin te/ de 'dra'i dge slong de rig spyod khyad par du 'phags pa la gnas bzhin par song bas/ myur du 'tshang yang rgya dgos na/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i yul ma yin par mi 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ma yin par bshad pa dang*/ de tsam gyis nyan thos kyi byang chub kyang mi thob na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ji skad du/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*/ bslab pa dag kyang gsung pa ni/ dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams/ de la zhugs pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /zhes thabs dang mi ldan pa'i ye shes te/ snying rje chen po 'khor bcas dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang bde chen 'khor bcas kyis ma zin pa'i spros bral tsam gyi stong nyid dang*/

nyes spyod sdom pa'i bslab bya rab 'byams gsungs pa tsam ni/ nyan thos kyi gdul bya rnams re zhig de tsam la bkod de/ de'i dgra bcom sogs thob na/ slar yang theg pa chen po la 'jug pa'i don tsam yin zhes gsungs na/ khyed kyi lugs kyi rig spyod pa de la ni/ re zhig theg chen la 'jug pa'i skal pa med pa yang mang du snang bas/ 'di ci zhig bya/ dge slong sngags kyi rten mchog yin pas so snyam na/ yin mod de ni shin tu ma nges te/ de lta na nyid dag rig spyod khyad par du 'phags pa mi lus rin po che cis kyang ci phyir mi 'chad/ nyes par spyod pa mtha' dag sdom zhing dge ba'i chos la rtse gcig tu spyod pa sems can ma lus pa sgrol ba'i rlabs chen gyi spyod pa dang 'brel ba byang chub sems pa'i sdom pas kyang*/ mthar thug gi spyod par mi 'gyur na/ nyes spyod kyi cha shas sdom pa khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu sogs/ nye tshe tsam la gnas pa 'dis mthar thug gi spyod par ga la 'gyur/ spros pas chog go /spyod pa'i skabs kyi bde chen gyi tshul ni bogs 'byin yin la/ pho nya'i lam la ni gnyis yod de/ mi rtog pa khyad par can bde stong gi ye shes ma skyed pa bskyed pa'i don du phyag rgya'i lam la brten nas bde ba sngon song gi stong pa nyid khyad par can bsgom pa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ rnal 'byor lam dang pho nya'i lam gang la brten nas 'byung ba yin yang*/ ye shes de'i rgyun 'phel ba dang brtan par bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya bsten pa ste/ phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dus tha dad pa'i dbye bas gsum mo/ /dang po la yang rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum rim pas sgrub byed kyi phyag rgya'i sbyor ba dang*/ btsan thabs su sgrub byed de gnyis yod do/ /bde stong sgrub pa dang brtan 'phel byed pa la/ rang lus 'ba' zhig gis kyang 'grub par byar yod mod kyi/

bogs 'byin ni nges par phyag rgya la rag las so/ /bogs 'byin gyi de yin yang*/ spyod pa yin pas ni ma khyab ste/ 'dod yon gzhan sna tshogs dang spyod lam sna tshogs pa med par tshogs kyi cho ga'i rim pa yang med cing*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal gtso bor sgom pa yang med par/ snang ba'i rtogs pa skyes nas dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug gi phyir du pho nya'i lam tsam sgom pa yod la/ de la rig spyod kyi don gang yang ma tshang bas so/ /de'i phyir pho nya'i lam la rig spyod kyis khyab par smra ba ni shin tu ma brtags pa'o/ /pho nya'i gsum bskul ba'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa nyid nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag go /lū dril gyi rdzogs rim gnyis la yang*/ gzhi dus kyi rnam gzhag /lam dang ye shes kyi spyi chings*/ spyod pa'i rnam gzhag la sogs pa thun mong gi rim pa thams cad de ltar nges par byas nas/ nang sel mi 'dra ba dmigs pa'i khyad par dag bshad pa la/ gnyis pa lū yi pa'i gzhung las byung ba'i rdzogs rim bshad pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyi don dang*/ gzhung don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud 'dir/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus tsam las ma gsungs kyang rgyud sde gzhan nas 'byung ba'i cung zad kha bkang ste bshad na go ba chags par 'gyur bas/ 'di la shes bya rlung gi de nyid/ mtshon bya sngags kyi de nyid/ bsgom bya srog rtsol gyi rang bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni/ g.yo ba rlung gi skabs su bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa la/ sngags btu ba/ sngags kyi brda/ sngags kyi don/ sngags kyi don dam/ sngags kyi rtsa ba ste lnga las/ dang po la/ sngags btu gzhi/ ji ltar 'thu ba'i tshul/ sngags kyi ngo bo/ /de'i byed las te bzhi las/ dang po ni gshin rje gshed kyi bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ ā li kā l̥ grong khyer ni/ gsang sngags 'byung ba'i rtsa ba ste/ /zhes ā li kā li rnams so/

/gnyis pa ni/ dbyangs nas a yig dang*/ u yig gnyis/ gsal byed nas ma srog med de/ yi ge gsum btus pa las oṃ ste/ a'i yi ge u'i yi ge la o te pha rol la'ang yang bya'o/ /zhes a dang u phrad pas o ru gyur pa/ ma srog med rjes su nga ro thig ler gyur pa steng du bzhag pas oṃ mo/ /de bzhin du a yig gnyis dang*/ ha srog med bzhag pa mtshungs pa 'dra ba'i yi ge la ring por 'gyur te/ pha rol yang dbye'o/ /zhes pas a thung gnyis ring po gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ ha srog med rnam bcad du gyur pa'o/ /rnam bcad ha yig las 'byung ba ni/ bod na yod pa'i brda sprod kyi bstan bcos rnams las ma byung yang*/ gzhan rnams las yod par snang zhing*/ rgya gar ba rnams kyi ngag rgyun la rnam bcad ha sgra 'ba' zhig tu 'byung ngo*/ /ha srog med dang*/ u dang ma srog med rnams las gsal byed dbyangs med pha rol gyi yi ger drang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ ha u la sbyar bas hu yig tu song zhing*/ ma rjes su nga ror sbyar bas hūṃ ngo*/ /de dag nang du sbyar ba ni/ sngags btu gzhi ā li kā li ni rtsa nang gi rlung ā li kā li'i gdangs su gnas pa dag yin la/ de nyid 'thu ba'i tshul yang rdo rje 'phreng ba las rgyas par gsungs te/ snying po bsdus pa ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ a ni chos 'khor pad+mar gnas/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la ni khyab/ /'di nyid kho na rlung chen po/ /srog ces bya ba thams cad bsdus/ /zhes snying kha'i a thung las 'byung ba'i srog 'dzin gyi rlung de'i gdangs can dang*/ u ni longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/ /me dang nyi ma 'dra ba yi/ /mgrin pa'i mtha' nas spyi gtsug bar/ khyab pa gzi brjid kyi ni lus/ zhes gyen rgyu'i rlung mgrin pa nas spyi'i bar tu u yig gi gdangs kyis 'gro ba dang*/ bde chen 'khor lor zhes byar gnas/ /yi ge ma ni thig le tsam/ /mthe bo'i tshad ni sor bcu gnyis/

/rgyal po gtsug tor nang na gnas/ /smin mtshams nas logs su sor bcu gnyis gzhal pa'i gnas/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i lte bar byang chub kyi sems thig le gnas pa ste/ snying kha'i rlung a'i gdangs can la mgrin pa'i rlung u'i gdangs can 'dres pas o yig gdangs su gyur pa spyi bo'i thig le'i rlung snying kha'i gnas su phyin pas oṃ ru 'gyur te/ dbugs nang du 'ong ba na'o/ /mgrin par u yig 'byung ba ni/ yongs su grags pa mgrin par yi ge o yin pa dang mi 'gal te/ o yig gi yon tan o yig dang 'phel pa au yin pas so/ /des na rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dpe 'ga' zhig las/ o ni longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/ zhes 'byung ba'ang ma dag pa ma yin no/ /yi ge a ni sngar bshad zin/ /srog gi rlung ni mchog yin no/ /zhes snying ga'i rlung a yig gong bzhin dang*/ a ni chos 'khor pad+ma las/ /mgrin par yi ge a gnyis 'gyur/ /srog rtsol nyid dang thur sel ba/ /yi ge ha yi kun nas ni/ /mgrin pa'i dbus na gnas pas bcings/ / zhes gsungs te/ mgrin pa yan chad kyi rlung snying khar phyin nas gnas pa/ snying kha'i a thung dang 'brel bas a'i gdangs su song ba gzhi gnas srog 'dzin gyi rlung a'i gdangs can dang 'dren pas ā ring po'i gdangs su song zhing*/ der thur sel gyi rlung gi cha shas gnas pa ha yig sgra can du yod pas chog drag tu song ste/ āḥzhes bya'i gdangs su gyur te rlung gnas pa'i tshe'o/ /yang ha ni thur sel ming can rlung*/ /bshang sgo gsang ba'i dbus na gnas/ /yi ge u ni steng 'gro'i rlung*/ /mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dbus gnas pa/ /yi ge ma ni srog rlung yin/ /dpral pa rlung gi 'khor lo la/ /de dag gcig gyur snying ga la/ /thugs kyi sa bon du ni brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ thur sel ha'i sgra can dang*/ snying ka nas smin mtshams su rlung gi 'khor lo'i bar khyab pa/ srog ni ma'i dbyangs su 'gyur ba ste/

de'i don yang srog 'dzin gyi rlung spyi bo'i thig le la 'dres pa ma yig gi gdangs su 'gyur zhing*/ de'i rgyun smin mtshams kyi bar du 'gro ba yin la/ gyen rgyu yang steng du 'gro ba'i tshe/ ū ring po'i gdangs kyis 'gro ba'o/ /de rnams 'dzoms pas hūṃ yig ste/ thur sel gyi rlung mgrin par gyen rgyu dang 'dres pas/ hūṃ yig tu song ba spyi bor phyin pa na/ srog 'dzin ma yig gi gdangs dang 'dres pas hūṃ ste rlung

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ phyir £© 'gro ba na'o/ /'di ni slob dpon a laṅka ka la shas bshad pa dang*/ da lta 'phags skor la mkhas pa rnams 'chad pa bzhin te/ bde mchog gi rdor bzlas phal cher rlung nang du 'ong ba oṃ dang*/ gnas pa āḥdang phyir 'gro ba hūṃ ring por mdzad pa 'phags skor ba'i lugs ji ltar ba bzhin snang bas de ltar bshad pa'o/ /gu ru ni rbā ṇa shrī zhal snga nas la/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i sngags btu skabs 'phags skor gyi dngos bstan pa dang bstun nas 'chad zhus pas/ de ni yi ge'i don la shin tu ma zhugs pa ste/ rlung gi 'khor lo la ni khyab/ /ces sogs ni rlung phyir 'gro ba kho na la gsal zhing*/ des na/ 'di'i man ngag du 'byung ba oṃ/ 'jug pa āḥ gnas pa hūṃ dang sbyor ba rgyud don la shin tu 'byor zhing*/ de dag gcig gyur snying ga la/ zhes sogs kyang dbugs phyir 'gro ba ma yin par gsal te/ phyir 'gro ba rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar na/ gcig gyur hūṃ gi gdangs su song ba ste/ spyi bo yan chad du 'byung ba las/ 'dir thugs kyi sa bon hūṃ gi gdangs snying gar 'byung bas gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang thugs kyi sa bon bslas pa'i gtso bor 'dod pa dbugs phyir 'gro ba la sbyor ba dang*/ rlung gi de nyid kyi skabs 'jug gnas ldang gsum gyi gtso bor gnas pa yin pa gnyis mi 'grig cing*/ des na 'phags skor ba'i lugs la yang man ngag sbas pa yin te/ āḥganas pa dang sbyor ba'i tshe āḥnyid bzlas pa'i gtso bor byed pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang 'dra ba gcig dgos pa yin no/ /des na rdo rje 'phreng ba'i don la rang lugs ni spyi bo'i rlung ma yig gi gdangs can la/ mgrin pa'i gyen rgyu me rlung o lam o'i gdangs can 'dres pas/ uṃ maṃ oṃ du gyur pa snying gar srog 'dzin a'i gdangs can spyi baur son pa dang 'dres pas oṃ maṃ oṃ ke sha can du 'gyur/ snying ga'i a la rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe/
