do/ /gsum pa ni/ drod chung ngu ma thob pa'am/ snang ba'i rtog pa ma skyes pa ste shin tu skal pa dman par gyur pas/ rim gnyis la mi brtson pa'am/ brtson yang dam tshig gi yan lag rnams ma dag pas/ tshe 'dir drod chung ngu ma thob pas bar do der sgyu lus gyi gzugs ma grub cing*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su skye ba yang ma thob na/ skye ba dang skye ba thams cad du chos dang ldan pa bde gshegs sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes pa'i/ lha'am mi'i rgyal po gsang sngags spyod par gyur te/ shin tu thogs kyang skye ba bdun gyis nges par 'grub la/ skye ba dang skye ba de thams cad du/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyis sgo nas nges pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa'i blo dang ldan zhing*/ rigs mthon por skye bas bzang ba dang*/ nga rgyal med pa dang*/ snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas bsdus pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam tshig rnams la gnas pa dang*/ mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang ba ste/ rdo rje slob dpon bsten tshul ji lta bas bsten pa dang*/ lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa sogs mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig thams cad 'chang ba dang*/ ngag du gsang sngags kyi rgyal po rin chen bzhi'am/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs bzla ba dang*/ yid bde stong zung 'jug bsgom pa ste/ tshe 'di dang bar dor ma grub na skye ba gzhan du yang gsang sngags spyad par gyur cig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyas bshad dang*/ don bsdu gnyis las/ dang po la gzhan rgyud kyis byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i lha la the tshom gcod pa dang*/ bsngo ba'i khyad par dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsam pa dang*/ khyad par gdul dka' 'dul ba'i tshul lo/ /'di rnams kyi tshig don ni go sla ste/ dang po ni bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ yi dam lha rnams dang*/

chos rdo rje theg pa dang 'bral ba med cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon dang he ru ka'i zhabs pad spyi bor gnas pa ste/ des rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis rlabs shing zhugs na/ rang gis kyang sems gtad pa dang dmigs pa tsam gyis tshad med pa'i 'gro ba yongs su smin zhing byin gyis rlobs par nus pa ste/ thabs kyi khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gi tshe rje btsun he ru ka lta bar 'dod pa dang*/ cung zad the tshom gcod pa'i dri ba bya bar 'dod na yang*/ mgon po rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ dpal khrag 'thung 'khor lo bde mchog sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams gegs med par mthong bar shog cig /ces sangs rgyas rnams rtag tu mthong ste/ de dag gi byin rlabs kyis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa dang*/ de rnams kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub pas 'gro don spyod pa rnams kyang don med du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan gyi mthu la brten nas/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun pas chos ston nus pa rnams rnal 'byor shin tu mthu dang ldan pa yin pas kyang 'grub ste/ 'gro ba'i don phul du phyin pa bsgrub nus pa yang thabs kyi khyad par ro/ /gsum pa ni/ ched du bya ba phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs nus pa'i sems can kun gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang*/ mthar thug tu phan pa byang chub kyi don sgrub phyir du yongs su bsngo ba'i tshul ni 'khor lo sdom pa dpal he ru ka nyid la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar gyur cig ces pa dang*/ bdag ni mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ reg pa'i sems can de rnams thams cad kyang myur du byang chub mchog la nges par 'khod par shog ces sogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi mdzad pa thams cad bdag gis byed pa dang*/ smon lam thams cad bdag gis bsgrub pa dang*/

sems can gcig kyang ma lus par bdag gis 'khor ba las 'dren par bsngo zhing/ de'i 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa 'di yang thabs kyi khyad par ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang dus gsum gy-i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang*/ bde ba cung zad yod pa thams cad 'gro ba kun la bsam sbyor gnyis kas sbyin pas sems can re re bzhin yang phan bde zad mi shes pa thob ste/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi 'byor bar smon pa dang*/ 'gro ba rnams kyi mi dge ba dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ yul yid du mi 'ong ba ci yod pa de kun thams cad bdag gis lus sems la smin par gyur nas/ skye bo kun sdig kun dang bral bar smon pa ste/ gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba yang 'di'i zhor la 'byung bas/ rtsa ba ni bdag gzhan brje ba ste/ de'i bsam sbyor gyi yi rang dang bcas pa 'di yang thabs mkhas chen po'o/ /lnga pa ni/ sems can gyi khams na sbyor bas gnod cing*/ bsam pas zhe gdug par byed pa kun thog ma nyid du myur bar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i thabs byed pa dang*/ khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam la ma dad cing skur ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa gsog pa'i bsod nams dman pa rnams ji ltar 'dul ba ltar/ dbang dang mngon spyaud la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyis rab tu btul nas/ thar lam 'di la brten nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par byed pa ste/ ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba rnams drag po la sogs pa'i thabs sna tshogs pas gdul ba 'di yang thabs mkhas pa'o/ /gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ mdor bsdu na skye ba thams cad du bla ma mchog gis rjes su bzung nas/ rim gnyis bsgom zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis thob nas/ tshad med pa'i zhing rnams su sprul pa bgrangs ba las 'das pa spros te/ mu mtha' med pa'i sems can yongs su smin par byed

pa'o/ /de la bla ma mchog de yang gang zhe na/ spyir rgyud nas mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams pa/ /rang bstod bla ma slob ma ni/ /blo bzang ldan pas mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i skyon spangs shing*/ brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtse ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /dad pa'i bdag nyid dbang po thul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba ste/ rtsod dus kyi mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'ang the tshom dang phyin ci log gi blos skyon dang ldan par mthong bas na/ de lta bu ma rnyed na yon tan shas che ba rnams blang ngo*/ /tshe 'di la mchog 'dod pa rnams kyis bsnyen par bya ba'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan dag yod dam med kyang sla ste/ rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba mngon sum du gzigs pa dang*/ thig le 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po brnyes shing*/ bde stong gi lam des slob ma 'khrid pa la yang mkhas pa ste/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'di nges par gal che'o/ /rang nyid tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba la de lta bu'i bla ma med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yin no/ /dus 'khor las kyang*/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi snying dang kha la gnas par 'gyur ba de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal lam sgo ni/ dpal don dam bsnyen pa las/ chags chen 'dod chags chen po las ni thugs bcings pa/ /dbang po'i bde ba gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs chen po can/ /phyag rgya dag la sbyar yang chags pa nyams mi mnga'/ /nyi zla dag gi lam la rnal 'byor rab tu nyams/ /shes rab me la rnal 'byor stobs kyis rab tu zhugs/ /dpag med bde ba'i bdud rtsi nyid la chags pa ste/ /sdig 'phrog rdo rje 'dzin pa de ni bla ma dpal zhes gsungs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba med pa'i bde ba thob pa dang*/ nyi zla ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gags pas gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa gzhig pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes me lta bu mngon du gyur pa rnams dgos par gsungs pa ltar te/ de ltar thugs la gnas par ma zad zhal la'ang gnas pa ste/ legs par ston mkhyen pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /lam gzhan du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phel tshul bstan nas de gal che bar bshad mod/ bla ma de bsgom shing de'i mos gus kho nas lam bgrod pa ni ma bshad la/ theg pa 'dir ni de yang gsungs te/ gang zag dbang po rnon po mchog rab tu gyur pa dag gi spyod yul can no/ /gsum pa thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes ngos bzung*/ de nyid rigs drug gi ngo bor gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rten khu ba nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar du brtan pa dang*/ rdul gy-i khams spyi bo nas nor bur brtan pas rnam smin gyi las zad nas rdo rje'i skur 'gyur te/ dper na/ dngul chu'i bcud len pa dang*/ me dang du ba sogs kyi sbyor bas bcos pa'i lcags ni gser du 'gyur te bcud len gyi nus pa lcags la brten pa'o/ kha cig 'di ni dus 'khor gyi lugs kho na ste/ de'i lugs la rags pa'i lus ma 'gyur bar rlung sems kyi sku 'grub pa med ces smra zhing*/ 'dus pa bde dgyes sogs la khams dkar dmar bcings pas de ltar 'gyur ba'i rnam gzhag mi byed/ zung 'jug gi sku yang rlung sems lhar song ba yin gyi/ sha khrag gi lus gnas 'gyur ba ma yin zhes smra ba ni/ shin tu rnam par ma brtags pa rgyud rnams la skur ba 'debs pa ste/ spyir bde dgyes gsang 'dus skor thams cad nas thig le bcings pas/ rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa kho nar bshad pa dang*/ man ngag lugs tha dad pa kun las mgrin gcig tu 'byung la/

de thams cad phar zhag gi gsang 'dus rdo rje 'phreng bar/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa rim lngar drangs pa rnams gsungs nas zung 'jug 'grub pa'i rgyu dang 'grub tshul 'chad pa na/ rdo rje rtse mor byang sems ni/ /'dzin pa'i lus kyi brtan pa nyid/ /de yis de nyid byang sems ni/ /rlung gi de nyid rab sbyor bas/ /rig pas steng du byed pa ni/ /rgas pa med par the tshom med/ /hūṃ ho rim bzhin zhes pa ni/ /'dzin pa steng du rnam par spel/ /sngar bshad pa yi bdud rtsi lnga/ /'di ni bcud kyi len du brjod/ /'di nyid kyis ni 'grub par byed/ /lcags kyi gser 'gyur byas nas ni/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya dngos grub che/ /zung du 'jug pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes rdo rje'i rtse mo nas thig le steng du rlung gi sbyor bas brtan pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ steng du bcings pas bdud rtsi lnga'i bcud len te dwangs ma bcings par rab mthar thug pas zung 'jug 'grub ces gsungs pas rim lngar lung drangs pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang*/ bden gnyis zung 'jug sogs gsungs pa'i 'di kho na yang lta dgos so/ /des na de ni sku'i chos dang*/ thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa dbyer med pas zung du 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas/ tshe 'dir sku gnyis thob pa ste/ sku phyag rgya chen po gzhan don gyi sku'am kun rdzob kyi sku'o/ /thugs rang don gyi sku'am don dam gyi sku'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i sems/ rnam shes las 'das pa ste/ kun gzhi gnas 'gyur ba spros pa'i chos kun de'i rang bzhin can yin kyang*/ de nyid spros pa'i ma gos pa ni mi bskyod pa dpal he ru ka dang*/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i stong nyid/ sangs rgyas sems can sogs 'khor 'das kyi dbye ba dang bral ba'i mnyam nyid las ma g.yos kyang*/

'du byed thams cad dang bral zhing lhun gyis grub par ci bzhed pa la dgyes dgur rol pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi skal pa dang 'tsham par dus las yol ba med par 'gro ba'i don thogs med du 'byung ba/ don yod grub pa ltar/ gzhan don spyod pa myur du 'jug pas rta mchog ste rta'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /rtag chad las grol ba mnyam pa nyid gzigs pas 'gyur ba ste phyin ci log du g.yo ba med pa rin 'byung ste/ rdo rje nyi ma'am gzi brjid rgyal po'o/ /rlung mi 'gyur ba sgra thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa a yig ste skye ba med pa'i ming tshig gi yi ge thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes/ 'gro ba thams cad la zhing thams cad du dus kun tu skad thams cad pas gang la gang 'dul du don du gang 'gyur ba de nyid grag stong du ston pa'i mtshan nyid can ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ste/ 'od dpag med do/ /rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa spra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi rang bzhin te de dang mtshungs pa sems dag pa'i snang cha tsam du shar ba'i zhing dang*/ sku dang 'byor pa sogs tshad med mu med cing 'byams klas pa ye shes gcig nyid kyi rnal rol du snang ba ni/ rgyal ba rtag pa ste rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rtag pa mchog tu khyab pa'i bdag nyid khyab pa dang rtag pa gnyis su med pa ni khyab bdag ste/ shes bya kun nas sgyu ma lta bur mthong ba ni stong pa'i ye shes dang rang bzhin bde ba chen po mngon du gyur pa bde stong gnyis su med pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ dag pa gnyis ldan 'di la 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa ni rgyas par bshad na 'byams klas par 'gyur mod kyi/ ci rigs pa nye bar phan pa rgya che ba dag brjod na/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags las gsungs pa'i 'bras bu'i tshul dang*/ thun mong ba mdo las kyang gsal ba 'byung ba rnams so/

/dang po la rten sku'i rnam gzhagakhyad par rigs kyi dbye ba/ brten pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa la rnam 'gyur dang rang bzhin gnyis las/ dang po la dbye ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ de rnams la yang 'bum phrag rigs can nyid/ /bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /de la rigs la grangs med rigs rnams nyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang bzhin don dam pa'i steng nas ni dbye ba med kyang*/ kun rdzob kyi cha shas la ltos nas phye ba'i phyir/ rigs kyi dbye ba'i mtha' bgrang bar mi spyod mod/ mdo tsam du bstan pa ni bla med spyi dbang du byas nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu sgrags/ /rdo rje skye mched gnyis dag kyang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu'i khams ni mā ma kī/ /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs sngags pa yis/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu sgoms/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs phung rnam snang zhes 'jog pa/ 'khor ba'i dus su gzugs phung du snang ba'i rnam par rig pa de gnas 'gyur ba ni/ ye shes nyid rang snang rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku mtshan dpes spras pa dang*/ de'i zhing dang 'byor ba'i bkod pa mu mtha' med pa dang bcas pa ste/ rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba yin la/ de la bla ma snga rabs pa rnams kyis gzugs phung gnas gyur rnam par snang mdzad ces dang*/ gzugs phung rnam snang gi ngo bor sangs rgyas zhes tha snyad mdzad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la sbyar te/ tshor ba ni rin 'byung dang*/ 'du shes 'od dpag med dang*/ 'du byed don yod grub pa dang*/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa dang*/ mig sa'i snying po dang*/

rna ba phyag na rdo rje dang*/ sna nam mkha'i snying po ste/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ lus sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ yid kun tu bzang po'o/ /sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu mā ma ki me gos dkar po/ rlung sgrom ma/ gzugs gzugs rdo rje ma/ sgra sgra rdo rje ma/ dri dri rdo rje ma/ ro ro rdo rje ma/ reg reg rdo rje ma/ chos khams nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rdo rje ma ste/ phung lnga khams bzhi skye mched bcu gnyis rnams te phung khams nyer gcig tu snang ba'i sems gnas gyur pa las/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor nyer gcig tu gyur te 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul byung bas/ gang zag gcig sangs rgyas pa na/ rang snang gis bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa'i bar du 'byung ngo/ /de rnams la rnam par dbye na/ rigs brgya'i bar du 'byung ba yin te/ sngar bshad pa'i phung khams nyer gcig po de las/ chos khams dang yid gnyis spy-i khyab tu btang nas/ bcu dgu po la gzhi'i dus kyi rigs lnga dang rigs mthun par sbyar te cha shas lnga lnga so sor phye ste/ bsdu bya rigs chung dgu bcu rtsa lnga dang*/ bsdu byed gzhi dus kyi ye shes lnga/ rigs chen rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/ rigs brgya'o/ /de dag kyang spyod bsdus sgron me las kyang rgyas par gsung*/ mdor bsdus tsam brjod na/ gzugs las phye ba'i rnam snang gi sogs rigs lnga ste/ dbyibs kyi gzugs rnam snang*/ rnam pa'i gzugs rin 'byung*/ kha dog snang mtha'/ 'od kyi snang ba don grub/ rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa/ 'di'i ngos 'dzin ni mngon pa ltar mi byed kyi/ gzugs kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de yin te/ rang rig pa'i gzugs zhes gsung ngo*/ /mkhris pa la sogs pa las skyes pa'i tshor ba mi bskyod pa/ bad kan dang rlung las skyes pa rin 'byung*/ bde ba 'od dpag med/ sdug bsngal don grub/ btang snyoms rnam snang*/ rkang gnyis pa yi 'du shes mi bskyod pa/

rkang bzhi pa'i rin 'byung*/ rkang med kyi snang mtha'/ rkang mang gi don grub/ mi g.yo zhing mi rgyu ba'i 'du shes rnam snang ngo*/ /'di'i lnga pa gzugs med khams kyi lha dang*/ gzhan rnams dngos su bstan pa'i sems can de rnams kyi 'du shes la 'chad pa dang*/ yang rim pas rtag mtha' lta bu mtha' gnyis char la brten pa dang*/ mtha' bzhi char la brten pa dang*/ mtshan ma re rer gcig tu zhen pa dang*/ yul sna tshogs pa la dngos po gcig tu 'dzin pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes kyang dam pa 'ga' zhig bzhed do/ /'du byed kyi phung po'i lus kyi 'du byed ni rnam snang*/ ngag gi 'od dpag med/ yid kyi mi bskyod pa/ khams gsum gyi rin 'byung*/ thar pa'i 'du byed don 'grub bo/ mig gi rnam shes rnam snang*/ rna ba'i rim 'byung*/ sna'i snang mtha'/ lce'i don grub/ lus kyi mi bskyod pa ste/ rgyal ba nyer lnga'o/ /skra dang*/ rus pa dang*/ phyi sa dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ snying ste nang dang*/ ri rab ste phyi'i khams de rnams su snang ba ni/ rnam snang gi spyan ma/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ nang spu dang sen mo/ rnag dang snying dang*/ phyi 'dzam bu gling ni rin 'byung*/ nang so dang pags pa/ sha dang snying*/ phyi ba glang spyod ni snang mtha'/ nang rgyus pa sha rtsib ma snying*/ phyi sgra mi snyan don grub/ nang dri ma rgyu ma mkhris pa snying*/ phyi lus 'phags po mi bskyod pa ste/ khams rnams so/ /phyi nang gi rim pa de bzhin du 'byung ba thams cad la sbyar te/ nang bad kan mchi ma/ phyi 'bab chu rnam snang*/ nang dri chu phyi rgya mtsho mi bskyod pa/ rdul dang chu bo rin 'byung*/ khrag dang bkod ma'i chu snang mtha'/ kha chu dang lteng ka don 'grub/ mgo bo'i drod dang rdo las byung ba'i me rnam snang*/ snying kha'i drod dang rgyun bzhag gi me mi bskyod pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo dang me shel sogs kyi me rin 'byung*/ yan lag gi drod dang shing gi me snang mtha'/

lto ba'i drod de zas 'ju bar byed pa dang nags kyi me don grub/ srog rlung dang shar gyi rlung mi bskyod pa/ thur sel dang lho'i rlung rin 'byung*/ gyen rgyu dang nub kyi snang mtha'/ me mnyam dang byang gi don grub/ khyab byed dang steng gi rlung rnam snang ste yul nyi shu'o/ /mig gi dbang po sa snying gi mi bskyod pa/ mig 'bras dkar po dbang rten rin 'byung*/ zur gyis blta ba snang mtha'/ mig g.yo ba don grub/ gzugs mchog dman 'bring gsum 'dzin pa rnam snang ngo*/ /rna ba'i dbang po mi bskyod pa/ rna ba'i rten khog pa rnam snang*/ bu ga snang mtha'/ rtsa ba don grub/ sgra gsum 'dzin pa rin 'byung ngo*/ /sna'i dbang po mi bskyod pa/ sna'i rang bzhin dbang rten rnam snang*/ sna'i bu ga rin 'byung*/ sbu gu don grub/ dri gsum 'dzin pa snang mtha'/ lce'i dbang po mi bskyod pa/ dbang rten rnam snang*/ rtsa ba rin 'byung*/ rtse mo snang mtha'/ ro gsum 'dzin pa don grub lus kyi dbang po rnam snang*/ rus pa rin 'byung*/ sha snang mtha'/ pags pa don grub/ reg bya gsum 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa ste/ sems dpa' nyer lnga'o/ /snang ba dang sgrib g.yogs med pa dang*/ yid la byed pa dang*/ mig gi dbang po'i tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu las/ gzugs mthong ba ni rnam snang*/ 'gying bag dang rol rtsed dang*/ sgeg pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa dang*/ rjes chags kyi gzugs kyi rin 'byung*/ mdzes mi mdzes bar ma gsum gyi 'du shes can gyi gzugs snang mtha'/ bya ba byed pa'i gzugs don grub/ rna ba'i nang gi sgra sogs rnam snang*/ glu'i sgra sogs rin 'byung*/ mgrin pa'i ngag gi sgra snang mtha'/ chu dang nags tshal dang yan lag dang rol mo'i sgra don grub/ yi ge hūṃ zhi drag sogs mi bskyod pa/ dri ma 'dus pa'i tshogs pa rnam snang*/ yan lag gi dri rin 'byung*/ dri gsum gyi bye brag phyed pa snang mtha'/

ro'i dri don grub/ dri'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa/ mngar ba rnam snang*/ bska ba rin 'byung*/ lan tsha ba snang mtha'/ kha ba mi bskyod pa/ tsha ba dang skyur ba sogs phyed pa don grub/ lhan gcig la gnas pa'i reg bya rnam snang*/ khyud pa'i rin 'byung*/ 'o byed pa'i snang mtha'/ rngub pa'i don grub/ bha ga dang ling ga sbyor ba'i reg bya mi bskyod pa ste lha nyer lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi dus kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam snang*/ mnyam nyid ye shes rin 'byung*/ /sor rtog ye shes 'od dpag med/ bya grub ye shes don grub/ chos dbyings ye shes mi bskyod pa'o/ /de ltar na phung khams skye mched brgyad po de dag gnas 'gyur ba ni/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyal ba rigs lnga la rigs chung lnga lngas phye bas nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de la yum bzhi bzhis phye bas rigs brgya ste/ yid gsum spyi khyab tu btang nas/ rnam shes lnga'i 'khor du gyur pa'i 'du byed lnga/ rgya chung ba dang*/ che ba dang tshad med pa dang*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ srid rtse'i 'du shes te/ 'du shes lnga 'dus te reg pa'i tshor ba lnga/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ rnam 'gyur gyi gzugs dang bu

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ ga £© nam mkha' dang*/ rang rig pa'i gzugs phung lnga/ de rnams 'byung ba bzhi bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i phyir brgya tham pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ dam pa'i rigs brgya'i rtsi tshul gzhan gsungs so/ /des na spyod bsdus sgron me las/ phung po khams dang de bzhin skye mched rnams/ /lnga po dbye ba lnga ru byas pa las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin brlabs nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di dag gang las 'byung*/ /de bzhin dbang po phyi rol yul bcas lnga/ /re re bzhin yang bde gshegags lnga rnams kyis/ /de la rtag tu byin gyis rlobs byed cing*/ ye shes lnga dang gsum du byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin mngon par rtogs na/ 'khor ba thams cad rtsa ba nas med pa yin zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di'i rnam snang gi rigs nyi shu rnam par snang mdzad nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs nyi shu rigs chen mi bskyod par 'du ba'i bar rigs lnga ste/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ / gar mkhan dang ni ri mo bzang ltar snang*/ /gang yang drug pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba/ /gcig pu rnams ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhi dus su phung po lnga lus ngag yid gsum du 'dus shing*/ don yod grub pa ni/ 'od dpag med dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan ni sku rdo rje 'dus pas/ rigs lnga po yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du 'du'o/ /zla gsang thig le las/ rigs ni rnam pa brgyar bshad de/ /mdo ru bsdu na rnam pa lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /gsum du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i don bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin ni/ gzhi dus su lus ngag gnyis kyang sems kyi rang snang yin pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus su rigs ji snyed pa thams cad kyang bde ba chen po'i rang snang gcig tu 'dus pa yin te/

gsang 'dus las/ khyod kyis sems lus lta bu dang*/ lus sems lta bu dang*/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig/ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni zung 'jug yon tan sum cu rtsa dgu ste/ yan lag bdun dang yon tan brgyad dang phra yang la sogs pa brgyad dang*/ ro myang brgyad dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad do/ /'di'i yon tan brgyad ni sa'i khams rang sar dag pas/ stobs mtha' yas par 'gyur ba dang*/ chu khams dag pas nad la sogs pa'i skyon nam yang med pa dang*/ me khams dag pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 'od kyis khyab par byed pa dang*/ rlung khams dag pas rdzu 'phrul yid ltar mgyogs pas 'gro ba dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dag pas gar yang phyin pa dang*/ nyi ma ste dmar cha dag pas sprul pa sna tshogs pa ston pa dang*/ zla ba ste khu ba dag pas bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang ba dang*/ rnam shes kyi khams dag pas dus thams cad du bde stong gi ye shes ma g.yos shing*/ dus gsum chags thogs med pa'i ye shes 'jug go /'di ni zung 'jug gi yon tan yin la/ sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang*/ zo mdog bde ba dang*/ gzi brjid che ba dang*/ g.yang sa la sogs pas mi gnod pa dang*/ mi snang ba dang*/ sprul pa ci rigs pa ston pa dang*/ grib ma med pa dang*/ mngon shes lnga ci rigs pa thob pa rnams sa sogs kyi yon tan du bshad pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyi yon tan du bshad do/ /ro myang brgyad ni/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ de nas mtha' med 'khor ba'i bar/ /rtag pa dang ni mi gdug dang*/ /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang*/ /bde ba dang ni dri med dang*/ /dga' ba dang ni yi rang ba/ /'di ni bde chen ro myang brgyad/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'khor ba ji srid bar gnas pa'i phyir rtag pa/ gzung ba la sogs pa'i rtog pas ma gos pa'i phyir na gdung ba med pa/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug la shes sgṛb kyi tsha gdung med pa dang*/ slob pa'i zung 'jug la yang*/

gnyis snang rags pa 'gags pas na bsil ba dang*/ bden gnyis dbyer med dang*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid du gyur pas gcig pa dang*/ sems 'gyur ba med pas bde ba dang*/ phyin ci log gi 'khrul pa dang bral bas dri ma med pa dang*/ zab gsal dbyer med las mi 'da' bas 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir dga' ba dang*/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pas chos nyid dang*/ sems can la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pas yid dang ba'am yid dga' ba'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni/ sgron gsal du/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod bskyed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes lung drangs te/ sku dpag med tu med pa cig car ston pa sku'i dbang phyug dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi skad du chos cig car ston pa gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ rtog pa med bzhin du shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa ston pa rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug dang*/ yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du rgyal ba khyab pa kun 'gro'i dbang phyug dang*/ stobs sogs yon tan thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pas gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ bzhed pa tsam gyis don thams cad rdzogs par 'grub pa ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ gdul bya mu med pa rnams la byang chub gsum po rgyud la bskyed par mdzad pa ni bskyed pa'i dbang phyug ste/ de rnams la dbang 'byor bas dbang phyug go /'ga' zhig gnas kyi dbang phyug mi bgrang zhing*/ yon tan gyi dbang phyug ces zur du byed pa ni/ rtsa ba dang dngos su 'gal lo/ /des na ci 'dod bskyed de yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin par gu ru lho phyogs pas gsung ngo*/ /yan lag bdun dang phra yang brgyad ni gong du bshad zin cing*/ ye shes de kho na nyid bdun ni/

rin chen snye mar gtan la phab zin to/ /'dir gzhan 'dod dang brda chad thun mong ba yin la/ ngo bo 'jog tshul mi 'dra ba 'di lta bu dag yod do/ /shes pa bcu la kun rdzob shes pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rgyu rkyen rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ci yod pa thams cad ji lta ba thams cad mkhyen zhing sgyur ma ltar rang bzhin med par gzigs pa'o/ /chos shes pas thabs kyi cha mkhyen pa ste/ de la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal chos shes ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa log ste/ rang bzhin dag pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gzigs pa'o/ /kun 'byung chos shes ni nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin ye shes dang*/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa gang yin pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i yan las su snang ba gang yin pa de'ang*/ gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i cha shas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa dang rang bzhin dbyer med du mthong ba'o/ /'gog pa chos shes ni/ spang bya glo bur ba gsar du 'gags shing*/ 'gags pa'i dbyings de yang bde ba chen por mthong ba'o/ /lam chos shes ni lam gyi chos thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas bde ba chen po rang rig rang gsal bar gnas pa de nyid kyi ngo bor gdod ma'i tshul gyis rang bzhin dbyer med du mthong ba'o/ /rjes su shes pa ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs te/ de la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal rjes shes ni/ chos shes kyi yul de nyid la dmigs nas bde ba chen por gzigs pa'o/ /kun 'byung rjes shes ni/ chos shes kyi yul la dmigs nas rang bzhin med pa gzigs pa'o/ /'gog pa rjes shes ni/ spang bya thams cad gdod ma nas 'gags par gzigs pa'o/ /lam rjes shes ni gzhi lam dbyer med de yang gdod ma nas stong pa'i rang bzhin du gzigs pa'o/ /bden bzhi shes pa ni/ chos shes rjes shes gnyis las logs su med kyang*/ re re bzhin ngo bo tsam ngos bzung na/ sdug bsngal rnam pa dkyil 'khor dang ngo bo bde ba chen por mthong ba ni sdug bsngal shes pa'o/

/kun 'byung gi rang bzhin ye shes 'phrin las dang bcas par shes pa yang rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs par yod pa ni/ kun 'byung shes pa'o/ /rang bzhin gdod ma nas 'gags pa glo bur du yang bral bar gzigs pa ni/ 'gog pa shes pa'o/ /gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa lam gyi ngo bor gnas pa de yang gdod ma nas stong par mthong ba ni/ lam shes pa'o/ /'di sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin 'gog bden dang*/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rang bzhin lam bden tu gnas pa mngon sum du mthong ba yin zhes pa 'di'i don shes pa gnad che'o/ /pha rol sems shes ni/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid du mthong ba'i ye shes kyis drangs pa'i mngon shes kyis srid pa dang zhi bas bsdus pa'i sems can skye 'gags thams cad kyi kun spyod thams cad shes pa'o/ /zad pa shes pa ni/ spang bya'i chos thams cad rang bzhin la gdod ma nas zad par shes pa'o/ /mi skye ba shes pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa de/ spang bya thams cad lam gyis spangs pas glo bur gyi skye ba'ang phyin chad gtan mi 'byung bar mthong ba'o/ /'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi shes pa bcu'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /mthong lam gyi chos shes rjes shes rnams kyang nyon sgrib kyi dbang du byas nas 'di'i rigs pas shes par bya zhing*/ sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ rjes bzod la sogs pa bzod pa brgyad po rnams ni shes pa brgyad kyis shes shing*/ mthong ba'i don bzod par byas te bsgom pa'o/ /'o na mthong lam mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug gi rang bzhin de rnams skad cig bcu drug tu 'chad pa'i phyir/ shes bzod bcu drug re re dang sbyor ba byed dam zhe na/ mi sbyor te/ sngags lugs kyi shes bzod bcu drug po 'di dag ni/ thog mar rtogs tshul kyi dbye bas/ shes bzod gnyis thob pa la snga phyi cung zad yod mod kyi/ lha ma mnyam bzhag gi thun de phal cher bcu drug po thams cad dus gcig tu bsgom pa yin te/

dmigs yul gyi ldog chas phye ba ma rtogs ye shes kyi ngo bo gcig yin no/ /dga' ba bcu drug ni byang chub kyi sems kyi steng du bgrod dbye bas snga phyi'i go rim ste/ mthong lam dga' ba'i skad cig ma bcu drug ces brjod pas/ shes bzod bcu drug yin par mi 'gro'o/ /de dag ni mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i nges don/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag gu ru shar phyogs pa las kho bos 'bad pas thob pa ste/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi skyes sngon chad gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa 'di/ kho bos gangs ri'i khrod du yongs su bsgrags kyi/ zang zing tsam don du gnyer ba ma yin pa'i/ mkhas pa rnams kyis yi rang ba dang bcas pas khas len pa'i 'os so/ /gsang sngags nang gi nges don gyi zhugs 'bras brgyud la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bden pa bzhi'i don rnam pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'ang*/ o rgyan gyi yul nas grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams las legs par rnyed pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ de'i man ngag kyang yod mod kyi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi rna drung du shub bu'i ngag gis brjod par bsam ste/ 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /shes bcu la sogs pa de kun yang*/ o ṭi ya na las byung ba rgyud kun las btus pa zhes bya ba nas 'byung ba yin zhes gsung ngo*/ /rgyud de ni dum bu dum bu'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i yul la yang mang du yod par snang zhing*/ phyogs 'di na o rgyan las byung ba'am gdan drangs pa yin zhes pa'i sgrub thabs dang man ngag thor bu sna tshogs pa 'di kun yang rgyud de las byung bar yid ches shing*/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas/ rgyud de la dum bu stong phrag brgyad yod ces gsung skad/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems skad cig mar mthong ba 'di/

mthong lam gyi ngo bo yin no zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni shin tu snying po las kyang snying po ste gnad dam par bzung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la/ sku'i rnam gzhag ni mdo tsam bshad zin pas yon tan dang 'phrin las gnyis kyi dang po yon tan ni/ rang don gyi sku'i yon tan dang*/ gzhan don gyi sku'i yon tan gnyis so/ /dang po ni chos sku'i yon tan te/ zag med kyi sde tshan nyair gcig la sogs pa rgyas par pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung las shes par bya la/ nye bar mkho ba cung zad cig brjod na/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad dang thugs rje chen po'o/ /dang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi stobs gcig nyid las/ mkhyen yul gyi sgo nas stobs bcu ste/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa mkhyen pa ste/ dper na mtho ris dang ngan song gi rgyu ni/ las dge sdig yin pa 'di ni gnas yin la/ bdag dang gtso bo dang dbang phyug la sogs pa ni/ mtho ris dang ngan song gi gnas dang rgyu ma yin pa dang lta bu ste des mtshon pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos gang dang gang thams cad kyi rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /gnas dang gnas min gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las shes par bya'o/ /las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ dge sdig gis las gang dang gang gis 'bras bu 'di 'byin zhes thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o/ /bsam gtan dang rnam thar dang ting nge 'dzin dang kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam par byang ba mkhyen pa'i stobs shes sam/ kun byang mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ zad par bcu la sogs pa'am theg pa chen po ltar na/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu rnams kyi bar du gcod pa'i chos kun nas nyon mongs dang*/

gnyen po 'phel ba'i chos rnam byang thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ sems can dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum dang*/ de'i rab dbye mtha' yas pa dang*/ de dag smin pa dang sad par byed pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ sems can gang dag theg gsum so so la mos pa dang*/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos tha dad la mos pa dang*/ mos pa de dag gi mthu che chung dang*/ rang bzhin bzang ngan thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ khams sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ khams dang rigs ni don gcig ste/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs so so dang*/ nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa dang*/ re zhig rigs tshad du gyur pa dang*/ skal ba dang bag chags shas che chung thams cad de mdor na rang bzhin dang rgyas 'gyur thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ 'khor ba'i lam 'gro ba rgyud lngar skyai ba'i las nyon rnams khams gsum du skye ba'i las thams cad mkhyen zhing zhi ba'i lam theg pa gsum gyi byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ bdag nyid kyi sngon gyi tshe rabs thams cad du gang cung zad yod pa thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o/ /'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mu mthar thug pa'i skye ba gzhan du med pa thams cad cig car mkhyen pa ste/ 'dis de rnams kyi sngon gyi tshe rabs thams cad ma lus par mkhyen pa'o/ /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ bdag nyid kyi spang bya thams cad zad de slar mi skye ba dang*/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ zag pa zad pa rnams la'ang de bzhin du ste thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang lhun gyis grub cing rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' bas/

gzigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa ste/ ci'i phyir stobs zhes bya na rang rgyud kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib pa thams cad bcom zhing*/ gzhan gyi'ang thams cad 'joms pas te/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma las/ stobs nyid ma rig sgrib la rdo rjai bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang 'di dag bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyir stobs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*/ /theg chen nges par 'byung ba las/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ /bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang thabs la bslu ba'i bdud ni/ mchod sbyin byas pas/ byed pa po dang bsad pa'i dud 'gro rnams kyang mtho ris su 'gro zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i thabs la sogs pa ston pa ste/ de ni stobs dang pos 'joms so/ /las dge sdig gis mtho ris dang ngan song du 'gro ba yin pa la/ dbang phyug la sogs pa la skyabs su song ma song dang mnyes ma mnyes kyis de dang der 'grau bar 'dod pa ni/ skyabs la bslu ba'i bdud de/ stobs gnyis pas 'joms so/ /bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin thar ba yin par 'dod pa sogs ni/ dag pa la bslu ba'i bdud de/ stobs gsum pas 'joms te/ des de dag gi sa bon spongs pa'i nus pa mkhyen zhing ston pas so/ /theg chen gyi rigs can theg dman la sbyor ba ni/ theg pa chen po la nges par bslu ba'i bdud de/ de ni stobs lhag ma bdun gyis 'joms so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang po gnyis rang don phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa la mi 'jigs pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa la mi 'jigs pa'o zhes nges par bya'o/ /de la chos thams cad mngon par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ chos thams cad mkhyen zhing thugs su chud pa yin pas de la 'jig rten na mthu che ba sus kyang de ltar ma yin zhes rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /'di ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'o/

/zag pa zad pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa zag pa thams cad zad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la rgol ba'i gnas med pa ste/ spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos lung ston pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'dod yon dang chags sogs thar pa la bar du gcod par mngon sum du gzigs pas/ de ltar ston pa la rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /nges par 'byung ba'i lam ston pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyis rnam par grol ba thob cing*/ gzhan gyis nam yang ma yin pa mngon sum du gzigs pa'i phyir/ de ltar ston pa la sus kyang rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rtogs pa dang ni spyod pa dang*/ /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las kyis/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ dang po rtogs pas bsdus pa drug gi sku la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba ni bstabs pa dang*/ brdeg 'chos pa la sogs pa sku'i spyod pa 'khrul ba'i rigs nam yang mi mnga' ba'o/ /gsungs la ca co mi mnga' ba ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dag grong stong par su yod ces smod pa sogs yod cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsung don med pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /thugs la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su slar mngon shes 'jug pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ dus thams cad du rtsol ba med par mkhyen pa'o/ /g.yo ba mi mnga' ba ni/ mnyam rjes so so med pas dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /tha dad pa'i 'du shes mi mnga' ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ nyon mongs kyi rang bzhin rnam byang du gzigs pa sogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pa'o/ /so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba ni/ gang cung zad sems can 'dul ba'i skal ba yod pa thams cad la/ dus las yol ba sogs btang snyoms gtan mi srid de/

rnam par mi rtog bzhin du dus las ma g.yo bar 'gro don mdzad pa la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa spyod pas bsdus pa drug la/ 'dun pa nyams pa med pa ni sems can ma lus pa'i don la mos pas/ 'dun pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa ni/ sems can gcig kho na'i phyir du yang bskal pa mtha' yas par brtson par mdzad pa ste/ 'bad rtsol med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ sku gsung thugs ngal ba mi mnga' ba'o/ /dran pa nyams pa med pa ni/ sems can gyi spyod pa dang*/ bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba thams cad gang gis 'dul ba sogs sngon gnas mkhyen zhing dran pa'i ye shes kyis zin pa'o/ /shes rab nyams pa med pa ni/ sems can gyi spyod pa dang mthun par chos sgo ston pa la zad pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa ni/ ji ltar brnyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi grangs tshad bzung med pa thams cad la dus thams cad du mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /rnam par graul ba nyams pa med pa ni phyogs res tsam las rnam par graul ba ma yin par nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis po las rdzogs par grol te mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa brnyes pa'o/ /gsum pa ye shes kyis bsdus pa gsum la/ 'das pa'i dus la ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa ni/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi bskal par chos ci byung ba thams cad ma nor bar mkhyen pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa gnyis kyang tha ma med pa'i bskal pa rnams su chos ci byung ba thams cad dang*/ da lta phyogs bcu na ci yod pa thams cad dus gcig tu ma 'khrul zhing ma 'dzing par mkhyen pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa gsum la/ lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa ni/ rang nyid kyis sngon mdzad do cog thams cad kyang skad cig gcig la dgongs pa la bzhag nas phyis ci mdzad pa thams cad kyang cig car ye shes des mkhyen zhing*/

rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa sku'i 'phrin las mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /ngag gi las thams cad/ ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa ni/ 'jug tshul 'dra ba la/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun par yan lag drug cu'i gsung gis chos ston pa'o/ / yid kyi 'phrin las ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa yang 'jug tshul 'dra ba las rtog pa dang spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ don dam par chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /'di dag rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rjes chen po bstan pa'i mdo'am/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las 'byung zhing*/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ yon tan drug cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad rgyu dang bcas shin tu rgyas par gsungs shing*/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la 'ga' zhig 'di dang 'dra min la re re bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs re bshad la/ ngo bo yang gzung dbang gis zhus pa'i lugs kyang 'di dang cung zad mi 'dra bar gsungs te/ rgyas par mdo sde de dag nyid don zab cing rgya che la zhal gsal bar yod pas nges par blta bar bya la/ de tsam mi nus na theg chen rgyud bla sogs dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa thugs rje chen po ni/ rgyas par mdo sde rnams su shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes nyin mtshan lan drug tu gzigs par bshad pa ni/ nyan thos dang thun mong gi mdo rnams kyi rjes su 'brang ba stai/ don la ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos dus rtag tu sems can rnams kyi bde sdug thams cad gzigs shing*/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung las sgrol ba'i dgongs pa mnga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang*/ /phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*/ /sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*/ /zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ /byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog /pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*/ /spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrung dang*/ /zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seṅge'i 'dra/ /'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ /'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang*/ /sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab/ /gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*/ /tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seṅge'i 'dra dang tshems/ /shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thabs bzang dang*/ /grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang pa dang*/ /spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhabs mthil mnyam par sa la phabs pa rus sbal gyi lto ba 'dra ba ni/ rus sbas gyi zhabs/ phyag zhabs gnyis kyi mthil bzhi dang phrag pa gnyis ltag pa'i phyogs rgyas pas bdun mtho ba'o/ /zhabs 'bur mi mngon pa ni bol tshigs 'bur mi mngon pa'o/ /byin pa e na ya'i 'dra ba ni/ mkhrems shing rim gyis 'phra ba'o/ /thal gong rgyas pa ni sgrog rus shas rgyas shing kyog mo med pa'o/ /rdzi ma ba mchog 'dra ba ni/ mthug cing ring la gzhol ba'o/ /gzhan rnams go sla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ /mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*/ /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*/ /seṅge glang chen bya dang ni/ khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*/ /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/

/byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*/ /gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*/ /shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ /yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*/ /gzigs pa sgrub med dag pa dang*/ /sku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*/ /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ /kun nas lta na sdug pa dang*/ /kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /rme ba gnag bag med pa dang*/ /phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*/ /phyag ring mdangs yod zab ring dang*/ /zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*/ /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*/ /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*/ /dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*/ /gsung mnyem 'jam dang mche ba zlum/ /rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*/ /mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ /spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug/pad+ma'i 'dam ma 'dra ba dang*/ /smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*/ /snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*/ /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*/ /nyams pa rnam par spangs ba dang*/ /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*/ /dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*/ /stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzing dang*/ /mi gshor dri zhim skyes bu yi/ /yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ /g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ /ces gsungs so/ /sen mo mtho ba ni ma zhom pa'o/ /long bu'i tshigs spob par mi mngon pa dang*/ zhabs gnyis ring thung phra sbom mnyam pa'o/ /mi la sogs pas steng gi 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pas seṅge'i stabs dang*/ klu la sogs pa sa 'og gi 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pas glang po che'i stabs dang nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i sems can dang*/

steng gi 'gro ba rnams zil gyis gnon pas/ bya ngang pa'am mkha' lding gi stabs dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi sna 'dren pas khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa'o/ /mtshan thams cad dod cing gsal bas yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /phyag gi dbyibs yang shing mdzes pas phyang nge ba'o/ /lte ba'i khung zab cing ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'o/ /zhal gyi sgo ha cang ches pa'i skyon dang gsung thag ha cang ring ba med pa'o/ /smin ma gnyis 'brel bas tshugs ring pa'o/ /dpral pa legs par rgyas shing 'bur du dod pas dbyes pa dang*/ skra mtshams mnyam par phyed pa'o/ /phyag zhabs la dpal gyi be'u dang*/ 'khor lo'i mu khyud la bkra shis pa'i ri mo bar ma chad pa bdun rim dang*/ g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i dbyibs can gru bzhi'i ri mos bskor ba'o/ /gzhan rnams ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ni/ sdoms su bsdu na/ 1mnyen 'jam 2yid 'ong 3yid du 4'thad/ /dag pa 5dri med 6rab tu 7gsal/ /snyan zhing 'jebs 8la mnyam par 9'os/ /mi tshugs 10snyon pa 11dul 12mi rtsub13/ /mi brlang 14rab dul 15rna bar snyan16/ /lus tshim 17byed dang sems tshim 18byed/ /snying dgar byed 19dang dga' bde 20bskyed/ /yongs su gdung med 21kun shes 22bya/ rnam par rig bya 23rnam gsal ba24/ /dga' bar 25byed dang mngon dga' 26byed/ /kun shes 27byed dang rnam rig 28byed/ /rigs 29pa 'brel ba 30zlos skyon 31 med/ /seṅge'i sgra yi shugs 32can dang*/ /glang chen sgra skad 33'brug sgra'i dbyangs34/ /klu dbang 35sgra dang dri za'i 36glu/ /ka la piṅka'i sgra 37dbyangs dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 38sgra dbyangs bsgrigs pa dang*/ /shang shang te'u'i 39sgra dbyangs grags/ /lha yi dbang po'i 40dbyangs ltar snyan/ /rnga sgra 41mi khengs 42mi mnga' 43ba/ /sgra kun gyi ni rjes su 44zhugs/ /tshig zur ma 45chag ma tshang 46med/ /ma zhum 47mi zhen 48rab dga' 49khyab50/

/chub dang 51rgyun chags 52'brel ba 53dang*/ /sgra kun rdzogs par byed pa 54dang*/ dbang kun 55tshim byed ma 56smad pa/ /mi 'gyur 57ma brtabs 58'khor kun 59grags/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog 60ldan no/ /gnyis pa 'phrin las ni/ rgyun mi chad par gang la gang 'dul gyi bkod pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par ston pa ni ngo bo ste/ gdul bya lam gyi rten dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu la 'god pa gsum mo/ /de la gnas skabs 'khor ba'i bde ba la 'god pa ni dang por gtogs la/ mthar thug byang chub gsum la 'god pa ni phyi ma gnyis so/ /dang po lam rnam gzhag nyams su len pa'i rten dal 'byor tshang ba la 'god pa'i 'phrin las la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang*/ kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ ngan 'gro ba rnams dang ba bskyed nas mtho ris la 'jog/las ngan gsog par 'gyur ba rnams gdam ngag bstan nas bzlog par mdzad/ 'dod yon la zhen pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin shas che ba rnams chos kyi sdom bzhis 'dul te/ dad pa dang nges 'byung gi blo bzang po bskyed par mdzad/ des na bsdu dngos bzhis bsdus nas tshogs lam la 'god spangs gnyen blang dor dang tshad med bzhi dang*/ thabs shes zung 'jug nyams len la 'god/ phyin drug gi go cha dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir sdig spongs dge sgrub la 'god/ de nas sbyor lam du gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par bsgom pa'i nyams len la 'god/ mthong lam du bdag med mngon sum rtogs pa la 'god/ sgom lam du spangs rtogs gong nas gong du spel ba la 'god pa de/ gdul bya'i sa dang lam gyi yon tan thams cad sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las yin no/ /de ltar bkod pas mthar thug rdzaugs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dam/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la sbyor bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de dag las rnam par phye ba dang*/
yon tan gyi rnam grangs dang*/ 'phrin las kyi rab tu dbye ba zhib mor brjod na shin tu mangs bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa smon lam gyi mtha' :dag cing

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dge zhing £© shis par byed pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ de ltar smon lam de dag kun/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'grub par mdzod/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lam bzang 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar bar shog /ces pa'o/ /de ltar rgyas par bshad pa thams cad bstan zin nas/ de dag nyid kyis don thams cad legs par bkrol ba'i phyir/ gal te lū yi pa'i bzhed don dang sbyar ba sogs shes par 'dod na/ khyad par cung zad dbye bar bya ste/ gtso bo'i zhal phyag gi skabs rtsa zhal nag cing g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab dmar g.yas ser spyan gsum ldan/ zhes dang*/ cang te'u dgra sta gri gug dang*/ /mdung rtse gsum pa g.yas pa yi/ /zhes dang*/ thod khrag rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ /zhes dang*/ sgo gsum gnyis spangs rnam rtog gcod/ /srid gsum 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes kyi ni sogs dang*/ bde chen thugs rje sogs gong 'og rje/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i skabs su/ bha ga nu rgyas gri gug dang*/ /cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa na/ /ce spyang glang po sogs sbyar/ 'khor gyi lha la/ thams cad rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zhing 'khyud/ /ces dang*/ sgo mtshams ma la/ yum bzhi ji lta ba nyid de/ rab khros mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gdul dka' 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang*/ 'khor rnams nyin mor byed la gnas/ /dril bu pa'i mdun bskyed skabs/ gtso bo lū yi'i dang 'dra/ bha ga nu ma rgyas :pa dang £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ la 'dud/ £© /gri gug kha ṭāṃ thod pa na/ /thams cad zhal gcig sogs nag po bzhin sgo mtshams ma la yum bzhi ji lta ba sogs dang*/ 'khor rnams lū yi pa dang 'dra'o/ /chos 'khor phyi'i rtsa brgyad po/ /yan lag rlung rnams rab rgyu ba/ /dbang po yul sogs 'don pa po'o/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs lū yi pa la bsrung ba'i 'khor los bdud bcom zhing*/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /stong pas 'chi ba'i srid sbyong pa'i/

/ting 'dzin zab mo sgom par shog /nā das bar do sbyong ba dang*/ /'byung bzhi lhun po pad+ma'i gdan/ /bha ga ma bu sogs sbrel lo/ /mngon byang lnga las dkyil 'khor mchog /'dod chags can rnams sogs sbyar/ nā da zhugs sogs skye srid sbyangs/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas gdab can/ /byang chub phyogs kyi dag par ldan/ /pho nya gsum bsres go cha bcing*/ /ye shes rgyas gdab sgom par shog /dbu mar rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dang*/ /rags dang phra dang stong pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje mchod pa'i bkog par bcas/ /sku gsum lam du byed par shog /phra thig 'od gsal bsdu ba yis/ /bde stong lha sku sogs sbyar te/ /nā da zhugs pas rab tu zhu/ zhes pa nas/ smin ma'i lam sgom shog gi bar bor ba'o/ /dril bu lugs ltar na/ phyi dkyil sogs zhar byung du snang bas 'dir mi 'chad/ lus dkyil bskyed rim gyi dbang du byas te/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags mthun rkyen sgrub/ /stong pas 'chi ba'i srid pa sbyangs/ /gzhi lus bar do sbyongs pa yi/ /ting 'dzin zab mo sgom par shog/skad cig rnam pas rang lus la/ /rten dang brten pa kun tshang ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor sgom pas skye srid sbyongs/ /thun mong sku gsum las bsgom shog /gzhi lus dkyil 'khor dag pa gsum/ /sprul pa longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ /chos sku lam du byed pa ste/ /'bras bu lam byed sgom par shog/pho nya bsre dang go cha dang*/ /ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur dang*/ /mchod bstod phra thig sgom pa dang*/ /bzlas pas rang rgyud sbyongs par shog/bde stong lha snang sogs sh+lau ka gcig /de nas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /snying khar dpa' bo yab yum sogs/ /bu ga'i rtsa la zhes pa chos 'khor phyi la ma mo brgyad/ ces 'don pa sgyur/ nā das bar do zhes pa nas/ dran pa gcig pa mngon gyur shog gi bar bor ba'o/ /'di lta bus rigs 'gre ste/

bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa'i bar du rgyas bsdus sbyar bar bya ste/ dril bu phyi dkyil dang*/ lā ba pa'i lugs/ me tri'i lugs dang*/ sdom 'byung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'grau/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ phag mo lha so bdun ma sogs yum gyi dkyil 'khor mang po rnams la rigs 'gre ste/ 'don bsgyur bas rgya cher 'gyur ro/ /da ni lū yi lugs bshad de/ khyad par ni 'di ltar ro/ /sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ dag pa gsum dran pa/ phung khams skye mched thams cad byin gyis rlobs pa gnyis ni/ rten yongs su sbyongs zhing byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom ste/ 'di la rā gur sngon du bskyed nas/ phyis phur btab byed pa yin te/ 'gal rkyen spong ba'o/ /de nas bsod nams tshogs gsog rgyas par byed de mthun rkyen sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'chi ba chos skur lam du 'khyer ba dang*/ bar do longs skur lam du 'khyer ba dang*/ skye ba sprul skur lam du 'khyer ba 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la stong nyid sgom pa'i dgos pa/ ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ sngags don/ sbyangs ba gzhi dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni stong nyid rtogs nus pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang*/gnas pa brtan pa dang*/ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i rgyudang*/ tha mal pa'i sgo gsum gyi rtogs pa spongs ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor thams cad stong pa'i rnam 'phrul tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ phan yon drug po de nyid slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyi 'grel par gsungs so/ /de'i dang po dbang po rnon po dang*/ gnyis pa 'bring po dang*/ phyi ma bzhi rtul po'i dbang du byas par skyes mchog rin chen bzang pos gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di la rgyas bsdus thams cad rung mod kyi/ gtso bor sdud rims khyad par can yod pa'i rgyas pa ni/ lwa ba pa'i 'grel pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing*/

nā ro pa'i man ngag rnams las 'byung ba/ pra dz+nyā rak+ṣ-i ta dang bhi bhu ti tsan+d+ras kyang bshad do/ /de ni dpral mgrin snying kha gsum du he ru ka zhes bya ba yi ge gsum bkod de nas sems can la snying rje bskyed la/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod de/ 'od zer spro bsdus snod bcud sbyangs/ oṃ āḥdang āḥhūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yang cha lnga'i bsdu tshul byas ste stong pa nyid la 'jug shū n+ya tā'i sngags don bsgom pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ oṃ ni mgo 'dren/ shū n+ya tā stong pa nyid/ dz+nyā na ni ye shes/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ swa bha wa ni rang bzhin/ at+ma ko ni bdag a haṃ ni nga'o/ /zhes pa ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid ni nga'o zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni he yig sogs yi ge gsum 'god pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ 'bru gsum 'od kyi spro bsdu byed pa ni/ snang ba gsum gyi bzhon pa'i rlung thim par byed pa dang mtshungs/ oṃ āḥl thim pa sogs ni/ snang ba gsum thim tshul dang*/ hūṃ cha lnga'i thim tshul sgom pa ni/ nyer thob rim gyis 'od gsal la 'jug pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' nā da 'jog pa yin zhing*/ zla ba dkar po ni pha'i khams dkar po/ zla ba dmar po ni ma'i rak+ta dmar po/ de gnyis kyi bar du nā da zhugs ma thag pa ni bar do 'gags pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ don dngos dang yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sprul sku lam byed/ chos sku lam byed/ longs sku lam byed gsum las/ dang po hūṃ cha lnga bsgom pa ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga/ 'od zer spro bsdu ni phung khams skye mched rnams rim gyis 'phel ba dang*/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig nyid la grub pa na/ mngal nas byung ste lus yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba dang 'dra'o/ /mngon spyod bla ma las/

sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhu ba glus bskul dang bral ba mngon byang lnga las rten brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed pa ni/ sgong skyes lta bu'i bskyed tshul zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa dran par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nang gi sgra tshul lam skad cig gis go cha chen po lus dkyil gsal btab ste bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ pho nya gsum bsre ba skad cig rnam pa'i man ngag dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab dang mchod bstod dang rnal 'byor chen po sgom pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ bzlas pa dang*/ rgyan sogs kyi dag pa dran pa'o/ /go cha bcing zhing thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa rnams so/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lugs 'di ni/ bshad rgyud rnams las shin tu gsal mod kyi/ rtsa rgyud las gang gis bstan zhe na/ de nyid bcu'i rnam gzhag yang lugs 'di la ches 'grig cing*/ khyad par rwa steng sna tshogs pad+ma yi/ /lte ba ā li kā li skyes/ /dbu ma'i bdag po rnam gnon zhing*/ /rdo rje dril bus sku la 'khyud/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i :phyi £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ phyad £© ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bskor/ /shrī he ru ka rgyal chen po/ /go 'phang mchog gi bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma/ /'khor bcas dbus su 'byor ldan pa/ /thams cad dges shing gnyis med gyur/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yin/ /zhes pas gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /dril bu lugs kyi ltar na/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor grub/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams grub pa'o/ /de'i rang bzhin mi shes rnams/ /snod du bya bar bzhed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus nyid rten dang brtain pa'i dkyil 'khor gy-i dag par gnas te/ lus kyi rten gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rtsa dang khams rnams kyi dkyil 'khor kyi lha rnams grub pa'o/

/de ltar gzhi'i dag pa'i tshul du gnas kyang*/ de'i rang bzhin mi shes pa rnams snod du bya ba'i phyir/ dbang bskur ba la sogs pa rnams nges par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'di'i don nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni rten byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ thun mong gi sku gsum lam byed sbyar tshul dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsum lam byed sbyar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sbyar yul stim pa'i rjes su lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bor mos nas/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa ni 'chi ba sbyong ba yin la/ de las skad cig gis gzhi lus gsal btab pa ni/ bar do'i lus bzhin lag thams cad skad cig gis grub pa dang mtshungs la/ de nas lus dkyil gsal gdab pa ni/ sngar rtsa rlung thig le 'gros mngon 'gyur med pa/ skye ba blangs nas rags pa'i cha shas thams cad 'grub pa ni/ de dang rnam pa mthun pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pas sbyong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ snga ma rnams dang 'dra mod kyi/ 'on kyang phyi dkyil med pas/ gzhi lus sgom pa sprul sku dang*/ lus dkyil longs sku dang*/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa ni chos sku lam byed de/ 'di'i lus dkyil 'ga' zhig nang gi sgra tshul gyi skyed pa'ang mdzad de/ 'gal ba med par mthong ngo*/ /de la nang gi sgra tshul ni spyi bo'i thig le dang*/ lte ba'i gtum mo snying khar phrad pa'i don te/ lus nang gi mngon byang zhes kyang bya'o/ /yan lag ni pho nya gsum bsre ba man chad lta bu lū yi pa dang mtshungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bzlas pa dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang*/ go cha bcings pa dang*/ dag pa gsum dran pas thun mtshams la 'jug pa yin no/ /de ltar na brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dag gis lam 'di la 'bad par bya ba yin mod kyi/ de ltar na yang theg pa'i mchog 'di ni/ rigs dang gzugs dang thos pa dang*/

brtson 'grus dang*/ sgrib pa'i blo can rnams kyi spyod yul du 'gyur ba ni ma nges te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni nges par shin tu myur ba'i lam bzang po rnams dang phrad par smon lam btab pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yongs su smin pa gang yin pa de kho na'i spyod yul te/ skal pa dang bral ba blo gros chen por rlom pa dag gis ni theg pa 'di ring du spangs pa sha stag ste/ kha cig ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod yongs su spongs bar yang byed la/ phal cher ni tshig tsam la gus par zad de/ theg pa 'dir dang por dbang bskur ba nas brtsams nas/ mtha' ma mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par 'gal ba'i spyod pa snang ba mang du byung bas/ 'phags pa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul yin no snyams te don spangs par byed la/ gzhan yang mang po dag ni/ de kho na nyid med bzhin du 'gal ba'i spyod pa dag byas nas g.yang sar 'khṛd pa dag kyang mthong ngo*/ /ma lus rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po ni/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /sdom pa'i rgyud sde ma rgyud bye ba phrag/bcu drug rgyal phran rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /des na zab pa dang rgya chai ba'i lam 'di nyid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su goms par byed pa rnams la rnam par 'phel ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ zhing khams rgya mtsho dag na dges rol pa/ /'dren pa'i mchog gyur rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnal 'byor dbang mor bcas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed pa/ /de dag kun gyi 'jug ngogs gcig pu ni/ /zab mo'i mthar thug bde stong zung 'jug dang*/ /rgya chen rang sems dag pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ /zab dang rgya che zung 'jug lhan cig skyes/ /bla med theg pa'i lam gyi snying po mchog/sems can rnams la sangs rgyas 'bras stsol ba/ /skal ldan bla mar gus rnams skye ba 'dir/

/dngos grub gnyis kyi 'byor bas skal bzang byed/ /grangs med gsum du dka' spyad ngal bsten kyang*/ /'bras bu'i mthar thug rdzogs par mi thob cing*/ /gzhan ni bdag nyid 'ba' zhig grol 'dod pas/ stong nyid bsgom pas byang chub nyi tshe sgrub/ /rang gi bu la'ang byams pa dang bral ba/ /snying rje dam pa'i 'phags pa de dag ni/ /bdag nyid bde med gzhan yang mi grol bas/ /byis pa bzhin du shin tu khrel por yin/ /'gro ba kun gyi khur 'dzin blo chen dag/nges par rdo rje'i theg 'dir 'bad par byos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mngon du ma gyur na/ /'gro ba'i don yang cha shas tsam zhig yin/ /pha mar gyur pa nyin gcig sdug bsngal yang*/ /byang chub sems dpas bzod par mi byed na/ /da lta sangs rgyas sgrub tu yod bzhin du/ /mtha' yas bskal par ci'i phyir thogs par byed/ /bdag nyid bde ba don du gnyer bzhin du/ /tshe 'dir bla med byang chub bde ba'i lam/ /nges par sgrub pa 'di la yid skrag nas/ /lhag med dbyings su 'jug par mos 'di mtshar/ /de ltar thub pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje theg gang rab tu gsal byed rnam par bshad pa ni/ /'gro rnams rmongs pas rnam par 'khor byed ma rig thib po bcad nas dam pa'i lam mchog rab gsal bar/ /byed pa 'di la ya mtshan ci yang skyes te rab dga' zlos gar bsgyur mkhas chu khur gzhon nu dag/phyogs kyi rnga chen yang yang rdung bar byed cing kun gsal bu mo me tog 'phreng mdzes ci yang 'dzin/ /dus gzhan zhig na shin tu nyal ba'i yid kyi chu gter dag la yang yang 'jug byed rmi lam gyi/ /gru chen gang zhig rdo rje lha mo'i lam du rab dkar dge mtshan ba dan mngon g.yo ba/ /'gro la 'dod dgu sbyin byed dka' yi nor bus yongs bkang 'di ko srid gsum dbul ba yongs sel zhing*/ /mtha' dag yon tan tshogs kyi phyogs kun rab brdal ye shes bla med mchog gi dpal 'byor rgyas byed yin/

/ye shes nyi zer mchog gi dman yang sngon rab 'dzin ma las 'thon bsod nams mchog gi dbyar skyes 'phreng*/ skal bzang bsil 'dzin thig les dge legs byin pa'i bdag blo 'di ni nges par thar par 'dod rnams kyi/ mchog tu dag pa'i kun gzhi'i zhing sar khyab bdag lo tog nges par bskrun byed zab dang rgya che yi/ /man ngag tshul bzhin legs par bshad pa'i char rgyun kun gyi 'byung gnas gyur pa 'di las rmad byung ci/ /grub pa kun gyis rab tu bsten/ /dam pa du mas dgyes par rol/ /cho 'phrul rgyun mi chad pa'i gnas/ /dpal ldan stag lung thang du bshad/ /theg pa mchog gi don kun yang bshad na/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu zhes par 'dus/ /chos kun rang sems rtsa ba stong pa nyid/ / sems ni gsal stong bde ba rgyun mi chad/ /sems kyi snang ba snod dang lus su snang*/ /phung khams skye mched sogs su ci snang ba/ /rang bzhin bde stong chos sku'i nyer len rigs/ /snang ba sna tshogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rgyu/ /ngo bo rang bzhin 'gyur ba mi brtan pa/ /'di ni rgyu yi rgyud du kho bos 'dod/ /dbang gi ye shes thun mong min pa'i sgo/ /tshe 'di dang ni 'khor ba'i bde ba yang*/ /rang bzhin mi shes byis pa 'bring mthong bzhin/ /rang don don gnyer blo chung khrel med du/ /mthong nas 'khor 'das gnyis las nges par 'byung*/ /'di ni mdo sngags thun mong lam gyi sgo/ /dbang bskur bas ni rigs la sos btab ste/ /tha mal snang ba rags pa spyod byed pa'i/ /snang stong bde ba bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan/ /snang ba rtog bcas stong pa'am blos byas dang*/ /bde ba'ang mi brten zhen pa bcas phyir dman/ /rtsa rlung phra thig nang gi srog rtsol dang*/ /mtshan ldan dga' ba'i sa gzhi phyi yi ste/ /spros bcas gtsor gyur gzhi dang phyag chen te/ /lnga pa'i mtshan nyid gtum mo 'bar bar bcas/ /rnam bcas rnam med gtso bor spros med de/

/rang bzhin yod med yin min kun bral zhing*/ /'dzin med ci yang 'char ba lta ba'i gnad/ /lta bar rim gnyis kun la gnad du che/ /sdom blang dam tshig ldan pas mngon sgrub na/ /rim pa gnyis la nus pa nges pa rnyed/ /de nas spyod pa spyad pas thun mong dang*/ /mchog gi dngos grub dka' ba med par 'grub/ /snang ba sna tshogs phyag rgya'i bde bar bcas/ /sngar bstan ye shes bogs 'byin spyod pa ste/ /nye rgyud mthong ba'i lam dang sangs rgyas tshe/ /dbang gi spyod pa'i nye rgyu nges par dgos/ /skabs 'di'i bde ba lhan skyes rnam gnyis yin/ /snang ba gsum dang rang bzhin brgyad cu po/ /sgom dang mthong ba'i lam la spang bya ste/ /spang bya'i gsal stong bde ba lam du byed/ /ma dag sgyu lus rlung sems tsam gyis sku/ /dag pa'i sgyu lus gnyis med ye shes sku/ /zung 'jug lam 'di'ang spyod pas bogs 'don byed/ /gzhi yi rang bzhin dag pa mngon gyur :gtso

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ tshe/ £© /'bras bu'i rgyud ces de la brjod pa yin/ gzhi 'bras ngo bo gcig tshul 'di shes na/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid don la nges rnyed 'gyur/ /sku dang ye shes yon tan 'phrin las rnams/ /rigs med sems nyid dag pa'i snang ba yin/ /rab rib bsal na gzugs kun mthong ba ltar/ / spangs rtogs ngo bo dbyer med nyid du reg/lam 'dir sogs yengs £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ mos pas khengs £© dag dngos po kun/ /yongs su btang ste bla mar gus btud nas/ /rtse gcig sgrub na 'phral du mngon du byed/ /de ltar don bsdus nges pa bskyed par mdzod/ kha ba can gyi mkhas grub ni/ /kun gyi dgongs pa 'dir 'dus la/ /'phags yul grub chen thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa'i snying po 'di kho na/ /sdeb sbyor gtso bor ma byas te/ /mchog tu go sla'i ngag gis brjod/ /sngags su ma zad mdo don gyi/ /snying po'ang mchog tu gsal bar byas/ /de phyir 'di ni mdo dang rgyud/ /kun gyi spyi 'grel chen mo yin/ /lung rigs gis grub man ngag lugs/ /log rtog dri mas ma gos pa'o/ /ye shes 'byor pas mngon khengs pa/ /rigs sngags 'chang dbang mkhas rnams kyis/ khyab bdag lam 'di yang dang yang*/ /bshad cing mngon sum lam du mdzad/ /dus kyi dbang gis de dag rnams/ /mthong ba'i yul las 'das pa na/ /tshig gis dregs pa'i mkhas mang rnams/ /tha dad mi mthun brtsod par gyur/ /rtog ges bslad pas de yi lam/ /ring du gom par byed pa yang*/ / mngon sum lam byed dang bral zhing*/ /ngal ba 'bras med 'ba' zhig snang*/ /phan tshun ngan pa'i lam la dam par 'dzin zhing lam bzang dag la smod/ /phal cher sgrubs pa'i skal bas dman zhing dbang thang longs spyod gtso bor sgrub/ /ngur smrig tshul 'dzin mtshon char 'bebs mkhas phan bde'i lo tog brlag byed pa/ /'jigs rung dus 'dir ji bzhin sgrub cing 'chad pa 'di yang rgyal ba'i mthu/ /mos dge'i rlung bzhon gyis :'os

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ thos £© rjes gdams kyi/ /rkang drug zab mo glu len gyi gnags pa/ /mang thos char babs blo gros 'gram rgyas pa'i/ /sngon med phyogs kyi glang po'i sgra 'di bsgrags/ /skye ba'i rgya mtsho shin tu rgal dka' bar/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed pa ches dkon zhing*/ /kun rtogs rab tu yangs pa'i sa 'dir yang*/ /skal ldan gus par bcas pa'i nor bu nyung*/ /'du byed thams cad ston ka'i sprin mtshungs shing*/ /dpal 'byor 'di yang tshangs pa'i bu mo'i grogs/ /rnam g.yeng can gyi spre'u tshogs rab 'bar ba'i/ /nags mthong dkyu zhing sdug bsngal mda' 'khrug pa/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir byis pa rang nyams spyod/ /phyin ci log cing lta bas rnam par 'khrul/ /snying rje dman rnams 'di la nges 'byung nas/ /rtse gcig sgrub par thar pa don gnyer byed/ /dam pa'i blo chen mig 'khrul dang mtshungs pa'i/ /'khor ba 'di la ji mi snyams na yang*/ /mi shes 'jig rten rnams la snying brtse bas/ /bla med rgyal srid sgrub la mngon par brtson/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /bla mas byin brlabs rdo rje ma rnams kyis/ / grogs bcas zab mo'i don la blo rnyed pa/ /kuna~X dga'a~X snyinga~X posa~X rgya cher gsal bar byas/ /'di las rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di yang ring du gnas pa dang*/ /des ni ma gyur 'gro kun byang chub mchog tu myur reg gnas/ /zag med bde ba'i rol pa mchog la rtag tu rol bar gyur/ /de rgyu nges tshig 'di yang yul dus kun tu dar bar shog /ces 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi rgya cher bshad pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ rigs sngags 'chang mtha' dag gi nges pa'i tshigasbas pa'i don ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyis thugs rjes nye bar bzung bas/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'di'i skyes bu dam pa rigs sngags 'chang thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba rdzogs par 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas blo gros dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams kyis nye bar bskul ba dang*/

phyogs 'dzin spangs pa'i blo can rdo rje theg pa'i nges pa'i don legs par shes par 'dod pa rnams la mchog tu phan par mthong nas/ rang lo nyer drug tu nye bar kun ldan gyi lor chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bcu pa la dpal rtag lung thang dang nye ba'i dben gnas rnam rgyal rab brtan tu legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' rnam rgyal lo// //'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa spyi dang khyad par dpa' 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/maṅgalaṃ/ shu bha mastu sar+b+ba dza ga taṃ/ dge legs 'phel// //༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/ spyod 'chang dbang po bsil ldan sā la'i ljongs/ /ngur smrig gar mdzad sgrol mgon chen po yi/ /legs gsung rmad byung bde mchog bstod 'grel che/ /mi zad par gyi sgo 'phar phye zin der/ /par gyi grangs chad smad rtsa zhabs breg tu/ /btang ba'i glegs bam rdo leb dkar po'i 'od/ / gzur gnas kun da'i gnyen du 'phos gyur kyang*/ /dga' ba'i 'dzum zer ngo tshas zhum pa bzhin/ /de phyir tshul 'dir dad thob zha lu ba/ /blo gsal ming can gang gis gsol btab ngor/ /bla brang chen po'i 'phrin las dbang phyogs nas/ /chos sbyin zla ba nya gang deng 'dir shar/ /de yi legs byas bsil ba'i zer 'phreng gis/ /mtha' yas skye 'gro'i tsha gdung kun byang zhing*/ /zab lam rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i dpal bsten nas/ /lhan skyes bde chen lang tsho mngon gyur shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i smad cha bzhugs/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 359-- PAGE 1 -
